The method comprises the steps: receiving global model parameterswhich are issued by a server and updated by a label-free global model this time; performing pseudo supervision training on a local model to be trained according to the global model parameter and thepseudo label of the training sample to obtain a local model parameter; sending the local model parameters to a server, so that the server performs labeled global model updating in combination with theclients with the labeled samples according to the local model parameters sent by the clients to obtain global model parameters of new label-free global model updating, and issues the global model parameters to the clients; and repeating until a preset condition is met to stop training to obtain a target model. According to the invention, transverse federated learning can be carried out when onlya part of clients have a small number of labeled samples, so that the method is suitable for a real scene lacking label data, and the labor cost is saved.

title: Two-hop access and terminal direct connection network addressing mechanism and time slot scheduling method
abstract: The invention discloses a two-hop access and terminal direct connection network addressing mechanism and a time slot scheduling method. The method comprises the following steps: 1, constructing a two-hop access and terminal direct connection network topology; 2, setting an addressing mechanism in the network topology of two-hop access and terminal direct connection according to different service requirements; 3, designing a time frame structure for the network topology of two-hop access and terminal direct connection; 4, performing node network access and control time slot allocation based onthe designed time frame structure; and 5, after the node accesses the network and allocates the control time slot, performing time slot scheduling according to the communication service. According tothe method provided by the invention, the resource overhead can be reduced and the maximization of the system throughput can be realized while the timeliness of the time delay sensitive service is ensured.

title: Resource allocation method and device based on micro-service architecture, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a resource allocation method, device and equipment based on a micro-service architecture and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: receiving resource locking requests transmitted by a plurality of micro-services, and extracting resource identifiers contained in the resource locking requests; selecting a target micro-service from the micro-services accordingto a preset resource allocation mechanism; allocating resources corresponding to the resource identifier to the target micro-service and creating a distributed lock for the target micro-service; and when it is detected that the distributed lock is released, selecting the to-be-allocated micro-service from the remaining micro-services according to a preset resource allocation mechanism to perform resource allocation. According to the invention, the resource is allocated to the target micro-service through the resource identifier and the resource allocation mechanism in the resource locking request; the target micro-service is subjected to the locking operation, so that the stable allocation of the resources is ensured, and meanwhile, the micro-service to be allocated is selected from the remaining micro-services for resource allocation according to the resource allocation mechanism when the distributed lock is released, so that the disordered competition of different micro-services forthe resources is also avoided.

title: Neural network search method and system based on knowledge distillation
abstract: The invention discloses a neural network search method and system based on knowledge distillation, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a neural network search space, enabling a data flowto select any basic network structure in each search neural network subspace, and transmitting the data flow in a certain direction to form a directed acyclic graph set, thereby forming a neural supernetwork; dividing the neural super network into a plurality of subspace blocks according to different depths; independently training the plurality of sub-space blocks based on knowledge distillation,obtaining loss values corresponding to the directed acyclic graphs of the sub-space blocks, sorting the loss values in the sub-space blocks, and taking the sub-space block with the minimum loss valueas an optimal directed acyclic graph model; and combining the optimal models to obtain a target neural network. According to the method, the neural architecture search of the large search space is modularized to ensure that the potential candidate network structure is fairly trained, and the representation deviation caused by the shared parameters is reduced, so that the correct score of the candidate structure is ensured, the search effectiveness is improved by the correct model score and sorting, and the expansibility is good.

title: Distributed cooperative task scheduling method for mobile equipment in dense network
abstract: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a distributed cooperative task scheduling method for mobile equipment in a dense network. The method comprises: establishing a mobile equipment load model, a mobile equipment response time model and a mobile equipment energy consumption model; based on the above model, obtaining a minimized total energy consumption model of the mobile equipment in the dense network; then, based on the model, outputting a load state index of each mobile equipment when the load variance of all the mobile equipment is minimum; and obtaining a task scheduling scheme based on the mobile equipment load model, the minimized total energy consumption model of the mobile equipment in the dense network and the load state index of each mobile equipment enabling the load variance of all the mobile equipment to be minimum, and researching distributed collaborative task scheduling from the perspectives of load balancing and energy consumption. For mobile equipment with limited edge resources, the processing capacity can be greatly expanded through cooperation, and therefore tasks can be completed more effectively.

title: Optimal scheduling method and system suitable for generalized energy storage resources
abstract: The invention provides an optimal scheduling method and system suitable for generalized energy storage resources. The optimal scheduling method comprises the following steps: acquiring data related toeach resource in the generalized energy storage resources; performing identification based on the data related to each resource and each predefined generalized energy storage resource response characteristic model to obtain each generalized energy storage resource response characteristic model identification parameter; substituting the identification parameters into a pre-constructed microgrid scheduling optimization model to carry out optimization solution to obtain an optimal operation strategy, wherein the generalized energy storage resources are classified according to big data statistical information of generalized energy storage in a certain area, and the generalized energy storage resources comprise energy storage equipment and controllable loads with energy storage characteristics; establishing response characteristic models respectively; meanwhile, applying the obtained model as a constraint condition to optimization economic dispatch in the microgrid range, providing a basisfor regional generalized energy storage resource regulation and control management such that resources are dispatched accurately, efficiently and at low cost, and the dynamic integration of user sideresources, the peak clipping and valley filling of loads and the effective consumption of renewable energy sources are achieved.

title: Cluster task scheduling method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a cluster task scheduling method and device and a storage medium. The cluster task scheduling method comprises the steps of generating a calculation task transaction request based on an intelligent contract in response to an obtained calculation task; carrying out consensus on the calculation task transaction request based on a first consensus mechanism, outputting the calculation task transaction request passing the consensus to a block chain node of a block chain network, and the block chain node of the block chain network being a calculation node for calculating acalculation task; and determining a computing node for executing the computing task according to response information of the block chain node to the computing task transaction request. According to the invention, cluster tasks are scheduled based on the block chain technology, decentralization of cluster task scheduling is achieved, and the efficiency and stability of cluster task scheduling are effectively improved.

title: Service data acquisition method and device
abstract: Provided are a service data acquisition method and device, which relate to the technical field of communications, and can improve the efficiency of determining a target RH node (i.e., an RH node having a connection relationship with an MEC node (i.e., a first MEC node) in which service data corresponding to a service (e.g., a first service) is stored), thereby improving the acquisition efficiencyof service data. The method comprises the steps that a first MEC node sends a service data registration request message to a first RH node, and the service data registration request message comprisesa public key hash value corresponding to a first content provider, a service name of a first service and a region identifier corresponding to the first MEC node, and the service data registration request message is used for registering service data corresponding to a first service, and the first service is a service provided by a first content provider.

title: Internet-of-Things terminal device scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent buildings, and particularly provides an Internet-of-Things terminal device scheduling method and system, which can analyze first position information of a first terminal device corresponding to an anomaly detection result when the anomaly detection result is found in obtained detection results so as to determine a plurality of second terminal devices; and then the second permission level of the device cluster corresponding to each second terminal device is compared with the first permission level of the device cluster corresponding tothe first terminal device, and the detection sensitivity and the detection result transmission rate of the second terminal device are further adjusted according to the comparison result. Thus, when the abnormality detection result exists, the terminal device with low authority of the terminal device corresponding to the abnormality detection result can be compared for scheduling, so that accurateand real-time detection of the peripheral area of the position area corresponding to the abnormality detection result is realized, and timeliness and accuracy of detection can be ensured in case of emergency.

title: Offshore edge computing low-overhead cloud-side intelligent collaborative franchisee discovery method
abstract: The invention discloses an offshore edge computing low-overhead cloud-side intelligent collaborative franchisee discovery method, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing an offshorecloud-side intelligent collaborative service network framework based on edge computing, abstracting offshore edge computing node behavior characteristics, and establishing a node trust and recommendation quantitative comprehensive evaluation model capable of inhibiting joint cheating; fusing and clustering the quasi-franchisee nodes to different cooperative service pools according to the comprehensive attribute evaluation to realize hierarchical nearby service; based on the priority and the load balancing theory of the cooperative service request, designing a cooperative service pool establishment rule and a segment page type self-adaptive lightweight class, and searching for a credible cooperative service franchisee by reloading an evasion franchisee discovery algorithm. A Router View data set is used for carrying out simulation analysis on MCECSMEC model performance, and the results show that MCECSMEC reduces 57.7% and 55.04% of redundant transmission flow and 93.47% of link re-searching compared with AODV and SR algorithms, the load rate is stabilized at 65%, the influence of overload, hot areas and void effects on network performance can be effectively reduced, and marine edgecomputing cloud-edge intelligent cooperative service efficiency and quality are improved.

title: Multi-node cooperative computing unloading method based on energy consumption minimization
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-node cooperative computing unloading method based on energy consumption minimization, and the method takes network energy consumption minimization as a target function,comprehensively considers network time delay and QoS (Quality of Service) requirements, converts an optimization process into an integer linear programming problem, and realizes an optimization target by adopting a branch and bound method. Simulation analysis shows that compared with a traditional calculation unloading method, the multi-node cooperative calculation unloading method provided by the invention effectively reduces the network energy consumption, and ensures the execution of more data volumes at the same time. The method can be applied to a smart home scene, green communication ofthe smart home is realized, and a local user side supporting the Internet of Things (IoT) partitions a computing task and then unloads the computing task to a plurality of MEC nodes or a cloud side in parallel.

title: Mobile Web task dynamic migration method based on deep neural network
abstract: A mobile Web task dynamic migration method based on a deep neural network comprises a support vector machine classification algorithm learning module, a mobile device and Web application program information feature extraction module and an edge server or cloud server load rate calculation module. Aiming at the problem that a Web application program with high computation intensity is difficult to run on a mobile device with limited resources, the method comprises the following steps of: extracting information features such as a CPU (Central Processing Unit) state, a memory state, a network state, a Web worker computation amount of the Web application program and the like in the mobile device, and inputting processed feature information into an SVM (Support Vector Machine) classification algorithm to establish a prediction model; judging whether the Web task needs to be migrated to an edge server or a cloud server or not, and if the Web task needs to be migrated to the edge server or thecloud server, finding an optimal server for migration according to a calculation server load rate algorithm; and otherwise, performing executing locally. The method can effectively reduce Web application energy consumption and execution delay and quickly respond to users.

title: 5G heterogeneous network system and cooperative vehicle computing task unloading method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a 5G heterogeneous network system and a cooperative vehicle computing task unloading method thereof, and solves the problems of computing task imbalance, computing resource shortage and lack of dynamic cooperation among participant members. The small cellular base station in the edge computing and 5G heterogeneous network integrated system provides high-quality computing service for moving vehicles, and the macro cellular base station performs efficient management on computing resources of the small cellular base station. The method comprises the steps that a mobile vehicle sends a task unloading request; the macro cellular base station decides to execute a calculation task scheme and schedules the small cellular base station; after the task calculation is completed,the macro cellular base station and the moving vehicle negotiate a calculation task unloading service protocol in a two-round game; and after negotiation, the two parties deliver results or task rewards to complete the computing task unloading service. According to the method, scheduling, common result caching and price gaming are planned as a whole, the task completion rate and the effectivenessof participants are improved, and the method is used for providing efficient calculation task unloading service for automatic driving vehicles.

title: 5G data processing system and method based on mobile edge computing MEC
abstract: The invention provides a 5G data processing system and method based on mobile edge computing MEC, and is applied to the technical field of communication. The system comprises first terminal equipment,a 5G base station and a 5G user plane network element, wherein the first terminal device, the 5G base station and the 5G user plane network element are located in the same industrial park. Software and hardware decoupling is carried out on an industrial gateway through a 5G MEC edge cloud technology, a software processing function is deployed to an edge cloud virtualization platform and enhanced,the transformation cost of the industrial gateway of industrial equipment is reduced, and meanwhile, one-key remote replication, rapid deployment and remote maintenance are realized based on an MEC edge system of an operator, and the intelligent management of the industrial park is realized.

title: Deterministic airborne high-performance file transmission method and system
abstract: The invention provides a deterministic airborne high-performance file transmission method and system, the system comprises a server and at least one client, and at least one application software runson the client; a long message channel and a short message channel are arranged between the server and the client; by utilizing a distributed priority scheduling control mechanism based on static configuration, the file transmission service quality of different security level applications is ensured; and by utilizing the characteristic that an airborne network resource short message channel and a long message channel coexist, a message is controlled to pass through the short message channel, a data message passes through the long message channel, a response message transmission protocol is simplified, and the file transmission performance is improved. Short and long message resources are fully utilized, a transmission protocol response message is simplified, the file closing frequency is reduced, data copying is reduced, and the airborne file transmission efficiency is improved; and through the priority round-robin scheduling of the client and the server, the transmission service quality of applications with different security levels is ensured.

title: Block chain industrial Internet of Things data sharing method based on federated learning
abstract: The invention relates to a blockchain industrial Internet of Things data sharing method based on federated learning, and belongs to the technical field of industrial Internet of Things. The method comprises the steps that data collected by Internet of Things terminal devices is transmitted to a local block chain through a network, data needing to be shared is used for training a lossless learning model on the local block chain, a result is transmitted to a shared block chain, the same training model is stored on the shared block chain, integration calculation is carried out on the transmitted result. And finally a result is fed back to the user for use. According to the method, private data is prevented from being leaked, an enterprise can select blocks and data participating in operation according to requirements, and the operation performance is improved. In a data sharing transmission process, only an operation result and a model parameter ciphertext are transmitted, and a homomorphic encryption transmission mechanism is adopted, so that the transmission security is ensured.

title: Method and system for realizing efficient calculation of neural network
abstract: The invention provides a method for realizing efficient calculation of a neural network. The method can be operated on a reconfigurable processor. The reconfigurable processor has a set throughput , and has a plurality of types of arithmetic unit hardware. The method comprises the steps of obtaining quantization parameters according to an operation type, to-be-processed data and a processing amount; storing the to-be-processed data in a storage mode of a HWCn model, wherein n in the HWCn model is a set single storage number. and the single storage number corresponds to the processing amount; and obtaining a parallel number of the arithmetic units according to the single storage number to obtain an arithmetic unit combination; and registering the to-be-processed data and the intermediate calculation data called each time from the HWCn model according to the sequence of registers occupied by the plurality of calculation units. Therefore, in combination with quantization of the to-be-processed data and an efficient storage mode, the running speed and reliability of the neural network on hardware are improved through high-energy-efficiency assembly line design on the hardware. Meanwhile, the invention provides a system for realizing efficient calculation of the neural network.

title: Computing power sharing method based on network scheduling and related product
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a computing power sharing method based on network scheduling and a related product, which are applied to a distributed computing system, and the distributed computing system comprises an application function network element, a computing cooperation end and a computing demand end. The method comprises the steps that firstly, after an application function network element receives computing power service request information from a computing cooperation end or a computing demand end, computing power service capability inquiry information is sent to a preset target, and the preset target comprises the computing cooperation end and/or the computing demand end; the application function network element receives response information from a preset target and provides a computing power sharing service according to the response information, and finally the application function network element receives notification information which comprises notification information sent by the preset target when the preset target determines that the computing power sharing service is completed; through the method, the efficiency and the convenience of computing power sharing can be improved.

title: METHOD FOR OBFUSCATED AI MODEL TRAINING FOR DATA PROCESSING ACCELERATORS
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure discloses a method to obfuscate AI models. In one embodiment, a host communicates with a data processing (DP) accelerator to request an AI training by the DP accelerator. The DP accelerator (or system) receives an AI model training request from a host, where the AI model training request includes one or more model-obfuscation kernel algorithms, one or more AI models, and/or training input data. In response to receiving the AI model training request, the system trains the one or more AI models based on the training input data. In some embodiments, AI accelerator already has a copy of the AI model. After the AI models are trained, the system obfuscates, using the one or more model-obfuscation kernel algorithms, the one or more trained AI models. The system sends the obfuscated one or more trained AI models to the host.

title: Resource configuration method, terminal equipment and network equipment
abstract: Provided are a resource allocation method, a terminal device and a network device, applied to the technical field of communications, the embodiment of the present invention comprising: receiving a plurality of resource sets allocated by the network device, at least one resource set in the plurality of resource sets being associated with an HARQ process packet number; downlink control information sent by the network equipment is received, an HARQ process packet number associated with a target resource set where the downlink control information is located is determined, and the target resource set is one of the multiple resource sets; and determining a target HARQ identifier according to the HARQ identifier indicated in the downlink control information and the HARQ process group number associated with the target resource set.

title: CONGESTION CONTROL MEASURES IN MULTI-HOST NETWORK ADAPTER
abstract: A network adapter includes a host interface, a network interface, a memory and packet processing circuitry. The memory holds a shared buffer and multiple queues allocated to the multiple host processors. The packet processing circuitry is configured to receive from the network interface data packets destined to the host processors, to store payloads of at least some of the data packets in the shared buffer, to distribute headers of at least some of the data packets to the queues, to serve the data packets to the host processors by applying scheduling among the queues, to detect congestion in the data packets destined to a given host processor among the host processors, and, in response to the detected congestion, to mitigate the congestion in the data packets destined to the given host processor, while retaining uninterrupted processing of the data packets destined to the other host processors.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CONTEXT AWARE CYBERSECURITY
abstract: A system that detects malicious traffic flows in a network includes a computer system including a processor in communication with at least one memory device. The processor is programmed to store a plurality of context information about the network including a plurality of devices. The processor is also programmed to determine a network configuration of the network at a specific point in time. The processor is further programmed to generate one or more security policies for one or more devices of the plurality of devices in the network based on the network configuration and the plurality of context information. In addition, the processor is programmed to deploy the one or more security policies to the one or more devices in the network, wherein the one or more devices are configured to execute an algorithm to monitor communications on the network in view of a corresponding security policy of the one or more security policies.

title: COMMUNICATION PROCESSING METHOD AND APPARATUS, AND COMPUTER STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: Disclosed in embodiments of the present disclosure are a communication processing method and apparatus, and a computer storage medium. The method applied to a base station comprises: using a set of transmission configuration information (TCI) status indication signalings to indicate to a user equipment (UE) the TCI statuses of a plurality of channels.

title: INTER-NODE COMMUNICATION METHOD AND DEVICE BASED ON MULTIPLE PROCESSING NODES
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method, device, and communication configuration apparatus for performing inter-node communication based on a plurality of processing nodes. The communication configuration apparatus is included in a combined processing apparatus. The combined processing apparatus further includes an interconnection interface and other processing apparatus. The communication configuration apparatus interacts with other processing apparatus to jointly complete a computing operation specified by a user. The combined processing apparatus further includes a storage apparatus. The storage apparatus is connected to the communication configuration apparatus and other processing apparatuses, respectively. The storage apparatus is used for storing data of the communication configuration apparatus and other processing apparatus. A technical solution of the present disclosure may improve efficiency of the inter-chip communication.

title: COOPERATIVE REASONING METHOD AND COMMUNICATION APPARATUS
abstract: A collaborative inference method and a communication apparatus are provided, and relate to the field of communication technologies, to reduce a delay in obtaining a target inference result by a terminal device. The method includes: The terminal device determines a first inference result based on a first machine learning ML submodel, where the first ML submodel is a part of an ML model. The terminal device sends the first inference result. Then, the terminal device receives a target inference result, where the target inference result is an inference result that is of the ML model and that is determined based on the first inference result.

title: FEDERATED LEARNING PARTICIPANT SELECTION METHOD AND APPARATUS, AND DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: A federated learning participant selection method and apparatus, and a device and a storage medium. The federated learning participant selection method comprises: acquiring a plurality of participants to be selected (S11); respectively determining a data quality factor, a service factor and a stability factor of each of said participants (S12); and on the basis of the data quality factors, the service factors and the stability factors of the plurality of said participants, determining a selected participant (S13).

title: Apparatus for efficient arrangement of rescue resources in use of the unmanned aerial vehicle and method thereof and computer recordable medium stroring program to perform the method
abstract: Provided is a control device for efficient arrangement of rescue resources using an unmanned aerial vehicle. The control device comprises: an image collection unit which collects images on a plurality of zones in a disaster area through a wireless communication network from an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a photographing unit; a global image generation unit which extracts a plurality of feature points from the respective collected images on the plurality of zones, matches the plurality of feature points to calculate a relative distance of the feature points for the respective images, and generates a global image projected on the coordinate system for the entirety of the disaster area; a global image analysis unit which calculates a distribution chart of persons to be rescued, including geographical location information by each rescue area and the number of persons to be rescued by each rescue area, based on the global image; and a rescue resource allocation unit which arranges a plurality of rescue resource units based on the distribution chart of persons to be rescued.

title: System for dynamic autonomous vehicle service pricing
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method comprising receiving by an autonomous vehicle (“AV”) service provider a request for an AV service from a user, wherein the request identifies an origin and a destination for the AV service; identifying a plurality of possible routes between the origin and the destination; and, for each one of the plurality of possible routes assigning to the one of the possible routes at least one of a comfort score, a confidence score, and a risk an risk score based on data associated with the one of the possible routes determining a price for the one of the possible routes based on a combination of the at least one of the comfort score, the confidence score, and the risk score assigned to the one of the possible routes.

title: Vehicle trajectory prediction near or at traffic signal
abstract: A system and method for determining a predicted trajectory of a human-driven host vehicle as the human-driven host vehicle approaches a traffic signal. The method includes: obtaining a host vehicle-traffic light distance dx and a longitudinal host vehicle speed vx that are each taken when the human-driven host vehicle approaches the traffic signal; obtaining a traffic light signal phase Pt and an traffic light signal timing Tt; obtaining a time of day TOD; providing the host vehicle-traffic light distance dx, the longitudinal host vehicle speed vx, the traffic light signal phase Pt, the traffic light signal timing Tt, and the time of day TOD as input into an artificial intelligence (AI) vehicle trajectory prediction application, wherein the AI vehicle trajectory prediction application implements an AI vehicle trajectory prediction model; and determining the predicted trajectory of the human-driven host vehicle using the AI vehicle trajectory prediction application.

title: Delivery product assembly in collaboration with intelligent autonomous vehicle transportation system
abstract: Aspects of the present invention disclose a method for coordinating assembly of a final product in transit via an autonomous vehicle. The method includes one or more processors identifying a delivery request from a user for a product. The method further includes identifying suppliers of component parts of the product. The method further includes determining common delivery routes of the component parts of the product, wherein the common delivery routes includes respective routes from locations of the one or more suppliers to a delivery destination of the delivery request. The method further includes determining a delivery path to the delivery destination of the product based at least in part on the common delivery routes. The method further includes generating a final delivery plan corresponding to the product for one or more autonomous vehicles based at least in part on the delivery path and the suppliers of the component parts.

title: Method and system for secure online-learning against data poisoning attack
abstract: This disclosure relates generally to online learning against data poisoning attack. Conventional methods used data sanitization techniques for online learning against data poisoning attack. However, these methods do not remove poisoned data points from training dataset completely. Embodiments of the present disclosure method provide an influence based defense method for secure online learning against data poisoning attack. The method initially filters a subset of poisoned data points in the training dataset for training a machine learning model using data sanitization technique. Further the method computes an influence of the data points and performs an influence minimization based on a predefined threshold. Updated data points for the learning model are generated and used for training the machine learning model. The disclosed method can be used against data poisoning attacks in applications such as spam filtering, malware detection, recommender system and so on.

title: Signal randomization method and device of communication apparatus
abstract: The present specification relates to a method and a device for randomizing a signal that satisfies ε-differential privacy, the method receiving a signal having a specific value of a bit error rate (BER), and generating a randomized signal on the basis of the signal, and then transmitting the randomized signal to a machine learning server. If a differential privacy mechanism is provided in a physical layer, true randomness of a wireless channel causes security to be less vulnerable than that of a pseudo random mechanism provided by an application, communication delay is reduced, and the power of the device can be reduced.

title: METHOD FOR PROCESSING TASKS IN PARALLEL, DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a method for processing tasks in parallel, a device and a storage medium, and relate to a field of artificial intelligent technologies. The method includes: determining at least one parallel computing graph of a target task; determining a parallel computing graph and an operator scheduling scheme based on a hardware execution cost of each operator task of each of the at least one parallel computing graph in a cluster, in which the cluster includes a plurality of nodes for executing the plurality of operator tasks, and each parallel computing graph corresponds to at least one operator scheduling scheme; and scheduling and executing the plurality of operator tasks of the determined parallel computing graph in the cluster based on the determined parallel computing graph and the determined operator scheduling scheme.

title: CONTAINER ORCHESTRATION IN A CLUSTERED AND VIRTUALIZED COMPUTER SYSTEM
abstract: An example virtualized computing system includes a host cluster having a virtualization layer directly executing on hardware platforms of hosts, the virtualization layer supporting execution of virtual machines (VMs), the VMs including pod VMs, the pod VMs including container engines supporting execution of containers in the pod VMs; an orchestration control plane integrated with the virtualization layer, the orchestration control plane including a master server and pod VM controllers, the pod VM controllers executing in the virtualization layer external to the VMs, the pod VM controllers configured as agents of the master server to manage the pod VMs; pod VM agents, executing in the pod VMs, configured as agents of the pod VM controllers to manage the containers executing in the pod VMs.

title: SKEW-MITIGATED EVOLVING PREDICTION MODEL
abstract: Methods, computer program products, and systems are presented for service cost prediction using machine learning. A claims risk model is formed for predicting a per member per month cost based on variables trained in early prediction models and variables of claim record data from data sources. A training dataset for the claims risk model is modified based on a preconfigured cap value and two distinctive datasets are generated, which trains the claims risk model into a capped submodel and an outlier submodel, respectively. Each submodel makes prediction of the per member per month cost and a slice model interpolates a cost predicted by the capped submodel and another predicted by the outlier submodel. The splice model redistributes the outcomes of the capped submodel and the outlier submodel.

title: PEAK-TO-AVERAGE POWER RATIO (PAPR) REDUCTION TECHNIQUES
abstract: Techniques for peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) reduction are described. Wireless devices may provide signaling with respect to one or more PAPR shaping resources. For example, a wireless device may provide signaling of PAPR shaping capability information. PAPR shaping capability information may include information regarding one or more PAPR shaping resources the wireless device has a capability to implement. Additionally or alternatively, a wireless device may provide signaling of PAPR shaping information. PAPR shaping information may include information regarding shaping the signal by a wireless device prior to transmission in a communication link by implementing one or more PAPR shaping resources. Other aspects and features are also claimed and described.

title: METHOD, DEVICE, AND STORAGE MEDIUM FOR DEPLOYING MACHINE LEARNING MODEL
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method, a device, and a storage medium for deploying a machine learning model. The method includes: determining, at a first computing device, a configuration of a second computing device, wherein computing power of the first computing device is greater than that of the second computing device and the configuration of the second computing device indicates at least a processor architecture of the second computing device; acquiring a program code of a trained machine learning model corresponding to the configuration of the second computing device, wherein the program code is adapted to the processor architecture; and providing the program code of the machine learning model to the second computing device, for deploying the machine learning model on the second computing device.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR STATE-BASED RISK ANALYSIS AND MITIGATION FOR EXAM REGISTRATION AND DELIVERY PROCESSES
abstract: Systems and methods may involve processing of entity data by machine learning models to produce one or more aggregate risk scores, which may be compared to one or more thresholds to determine when one or more predefined actions should be taken. The entity data may be collected for various entities related to an exam registration and delivery process, which may include a candidate, an exam, a test center, an exam registration event, a proctor, and an exam delivery event. The exam registration and delivery process may include multiple states—each being associated with a different set of entities. Aggregate risk scores for a given state may be calculated using only entity data for the set of entities associated with that state. The predetermined actions taken may also be dependent on the current state.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR POST-TRAINING QUANTIZATION OF DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS WITH PER-CHANNEL QUANTIZATION MODE SELECTION
abstract: A method and system are provided. The method includes topologically sorting layers of a neural network, selecting a quantization process that utilizes a quantization of a previous layer, and determining, with the selected quantization process, a quantization mode of one layer in the neural network based on the quantization of a previous layer.

title: Systems and Methods for Determining Molecular Properties with Atomic-Orbital-Based Features
abstract: Systems and methods for determining molecular structures based on atomic-orbital-based features are described. Atomic-orbital-based features can be utilized in combination with machine-learning methods to predict accurate properties, such as quantum mechanical energy, of molecular systems.

title: SIDELINK-ASSISTED UPDATE AGGREGATION IN FEDERATED LEARNING
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive a sidelink communication that includes a first local update associated with a machine learning component. The UE may transmit an aggregated local update based at least in part on the first local update associated with the machine learning component and a second local update associated with the machine learning component. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title: TARGET ACCOUNT DETECTION METHOD AND APPARATUS, ELECTRONIC DEVICE, AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: A target account detection method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The method includes: determining an active behavior timing feature of a target account to be detected according to active behavior data of the target account; determining an account feature of the target account according to account data of the target account; predicting a first probability that the target account is of a target type; and determining, in response to the first probability being greater than a target probability threshold, that the target account is of the target type. Detection is performed in the dimension of timing, so that the impact of an account of a target type pretending to be a normal account on detection can be reduced, and more accounts of the target type can be detected, thereby enlarging the identification coverage.

title: HARQ Feedback Codebook Including Deferred HARQ Feedback
abstract: A wireless may determine an initial timing of a first HARQ feedback and a first timing of second HARQ feedback(s). The wireless device may determine to defer the first HARQ feedback from the initial timing to the first timing. The wireless device may transmit, in the first timing, a HARQ feedback codebook comprising the first HARQ feedback and the second HARQ feedback(s). Based on the first HARQ feedback being deferred, a first position of the first HARQ feedback in the HARQ feedback codebook may be after second position(s) of the second HARQ feedback(s).

title: ELECTRONIC APPARATUS AND CONTROLLING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic apparatus. The electronic apparatus includes: a display, a memory storing at least one instruction, and a processor connected to the memory and the display and configured to control the electronic apparatus, the processor, by executing the at least one instruction, is configured to: based on receiving a command for adding a schedule being input while an image is displayed on the display, obtain a plurality of texts by performing text recognition of the image, obtain main datetime information corresponding to each of a plurality of pieces of schedule information and sub-datetime information corresponding to the main datetime information by causing the plurality of obtained texts to be provided to a first neural network model, and update schedule information of a user based on the obtained datetime information, and the first neural network model is configured to be trained to output main datetime information and sub-datetime information corresponding to the main datetime information based on receiving a plurality of pieces of datetime information.

title: DATA PROCESSING METHOD AND RELATED DEVICE
abstract: In a data processing method, a processing device obtains a first neural network model and an available resource state of a terminal device, and determines a second neural network model based on the first neural network model and the available resource state. An appropriate model size is determined based on the available resource state, and a part of the first neural network model is selected, based on the determined model size, as the second neural network model on which data processing is to be performed.

title: METHOD FOR OVERCOMING CATASTROPHIC FORGETTING THROUGH NEURON-LEVEL PLASTICITY CONTROL, AND COMPUTING SYSTEM PERFORMING SAME
abstract: A neuron-level plasticity control (NPC) addresses the issue of catastrophic forgetting in an artificial neural network. The plasticity of a network is controlled at a neuron level rather than at a connection level during training of a new task, thereby conserving existing knowledge. The neuron-level plasticity control evaluates the importance of each neuron and applies a low training speed to integrate important neurons. In addition, a scheduled NPC (SNPC) is provided that uses training schedule information to more clearly protect important neurons.

title: COMMUNICATION METHOD, APPARATUS, AND SYSTEM
abstract: Embodiments of this application provide example communication methods, devices, apparatuses, and systems. One example method includes receiving, by a terminal device and from a network device, a first identifier indicating a first communication mode of the terminal device. The first communication mode corresponds to a first physical layer function parameter used by the terminal device for communication. The first physical layer function parameter corresponding to the first communication mode is determined by the terminal device based on the first identifier and a first correspondence between a communication mode and a physical layer function parameter. Communication is performed based on the first physical layer function parameter corresponding to the first communication mode. The communication mode in the first correspondence includes the first communication mode.

title: OBSERVED ENVIRONMENTAL VECTOR FEEDBACK FOR WIRELESS COMMUNICATION
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a client may receive an observed environmental vector feedback configuration associated with a reporting procedure for reporting updates corresponding to at least one observed environmental vector that is based at least in part on one or more features associated with an environment of the client, wherein the observed environmental vector comprises input for a first machine learning component that determines client specific parameters for use by a second machine learning component. The client may transmit an update corresponding to the at least one observed environmental vector based at least in part on the observed environmental vector feedback configuration. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR PERFORMING BOX QUERIES IN RAY TRAVERSAL HARDWARE
abstract: Apparatus and method for box-box testing. For example, one embodiment of a processor comprises: a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) generator to construct a BVH comprising a plurality of hierarchically arranged BVH nodes; traversal circuitry to traverse query boxes through the BVH, the traversal circuitry to read a BVH node from a top of a BVH node stack and to read a query box from a local storage or memory, the traversal circuitry further comprising: box-box testing circuitry and/or logic to compare maximum and minimum X, Y, and Z coordinates of the BVH node and the query box and to generate an overlap indication if overlap is detected for each of the X, Y, and Z dimensions; distance determination circuitry and/or logic to generate a distance value representing an extent of overlap between the BVH node and the query box; and sorting circuitry and/or logic to sort the BVH node within a set of one or more additional BVH nodes based on the distance value.

title: TRAFFIC DISTRIBUTION METHOD, DEVICE AND SYSTEM, AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: Provided are a traffic distribution method, device and system, and a storage medium. In the embodiments of the present application, a data processing system comprises: an activation component, a storage queue, a capacity expansion component and a scheduling component, wherein the activation component can store a plurality of received requests in the storage queue; the capacity expansion component can expand the capacities of capacitor groups for the plurality of requests to obtain at least one capacitor group; and further, taking the number of requests allocated to each capacitor group not being greater than the number of concurrent requests that can be processed by the scheduling component as an objective, the scheduling component can distribute the plurality of requests in the storage queue to the at least one capacitor group. In this way, the data processing system cannot allocate the requests, which should be allocated to a capacitor group that has been successfully subjected to capacity expansion at a later point, to a capacitor group that has been successfully subjected to capacity expansion at an earlier point, so that traffic balance between the capacitor groups can be realized, thereby being conducive to increasing the resource utilization rate.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND TASK SCHEDULING METHOD USING SAME
abstract: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device may comprise a processor including multiple cores, and a memory for storing fault information related to at least one core, wherein the processor is configured to: when allocation of a task occurs, determine a first core to which the task is to be allocated among the multiple cores; identify a first operating frequency used in the first core to process the task; on the basis of the fault information related to the at least one core, check whether there is fault information of the first operating frequency of the first core; and if there is the fault information of the first operating frequency of the first core, change the first core to a second core and/or change the first operating frequency of the first core to a second operating frequency. Various other embodiments other than those provided in the present invention are possible.

title: IMPROVED CONCEPT FOR A REPRESENTATION OF NEURAL NETWORK PARAMETERS
abstract: Apparatus for generating a NN representation, configured to quantize an NN parameter onto a quantized value by determining a quantization parameter and a quantization value for the NN parameter so that from the quantization parameter, there is derivable a multiplier and a bit shift number. Additionally, the determining of the quantization parameter and the quantization value for the NN parameter is performed so that the quantized value of the NN parameter corresponds to a product between the quantization value and a factor, which depends on the multiplier, bit-shifted by a number of bits which depends on the bit shift number.

title: METHOD FOR SCHEDULING MULTIPLE SESSIONS IN WIRELESS COMMUNICATION SYSTEM, AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE SUPPORTING SAME
abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device comprising: a communication module supporting ultra-wideband communication; a memory for storing an application supporting a service using the ultra-wideband communication; a processor operatively connected to the communication module and the memory; and a scheduler operatively connected to the processor, wherein: the scheduler is configured to configure multiple sessions for communication with multiple external electronic devices, calculate an execution score for each of the multiple sessions, and perform scheduling for the multiple sessions on the basis of the execution score for each of the multiple sessions; and the execution score of each of the multiple sessions is calculated on the basis of at least one of a priority of an application corresponding to each of the multiple sessions, a role of the electronic device for each of the multiple sessions, duration of a ranging round of each of the multiple sessions, the number of ranging rounds, which have failed to be scheduled, for each of the multiple sessions, and a weight assigned to the number of the ranging rounds, which have failed to be scheduled. Various other embodiments identified through the present document are also possible.

title: TRAINING METHOD FOR DETECTION MODEL, SYSTEM, DEVICE, AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: Provided in the present application are a training method for a detection model, a system, a device, and a storage medium, related to the technical field of network security, and further related to applications of AI technology in the technical field of network security. Provided in some embodiments of the present application is a method for training a detection model by employing federated learning. In the method, a gateway device serves as a participant in federated learning, a server converges model parameters for the gateway device and issues shared malicious samples. When the gateway device is executing model training, the gateway device and the server exchange with each other information such as model parameters and shared samples, thus producing a detection model by training. The method facilitates the mitigation of the problem of insufficient malicious samples, drives the training of the detection model with enriched malicious samples, and enhances the effect of model training.

title: PRE-PROCESSING IN UPLIKNK RAN USING NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: In a base station of a radio access network, a distribution unit is confïgured to receive, through a radio head apparatus of the base station, a channel information signal transmitted by a user equipment over a radio channel, obtain based on the channel information signal compression model information indicating a neural network to be used for compression by the radio head apparatus amongst a set of neural networks, and sending the compression model information to the radio head apparatus. The radio head apparatus is confïgured to receive the compression model information from the central processing apparatus, receive a data signal from a user equipment over a radio channel, pre-proces the data signal, including compress the data signal by using a neural network, the neural network being selected based on the compression model information sent by the distribution unit, and transmit the pre-processed data signal to the central processing apparatus.

title: Intelligent security system based on Internet-of-things platform
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent security system based on an Internet-of-things platform, which comprises a sensing module, a network module and a system application module, and is characterized in that the sensing module acquires intelligent security and protection data in a power plant, sends the data to the system application module, receives a scheduling instruction and indicates intelligent security and protection equipment in the power plant to make a linkage response; the network module is used for accessing intelligent security and protection data outside the power plant, sending and receiving a scheduling instruction, receiving intelligent security and protection management data and providing the intelligent security and protection management data for a third-party Internet-of-things application; and the system application module is used for receiving and processing the intelligent security and protection data, generating intelligent security and protection management data inside the power plant, generating and sending intelligent security and protection management data outside the power plant and a scheduling instruction. According to the system, the intelligent security level of a power plant can be effectively improved, the manpower management and production cost is reduced, safety accidents and blockage management loopholes are prevented, and social benefitsand economic benefits are improved.

title: VR content caching method based on mobile edge computing network
abstract: The invention discloses a VR content caching method based on a mobile edge computing network. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a user mobile model in the network; calculating a transmission rate required by a base station to send content to a user; distributing a resource quantity required by the user to store the content in a next base station; establishing a VR content caching problem in the mobile edge computing network as a Markov decision problem, calculating a reward function of the user QoE; and establishing an optimization problem by taking maximization of the QoE of the user in the whole process as an optimization target, and solving by using a depth deterministic strategy gradient to obtain an optimal active caching strategy. The VR video acquisition time delay is reduced, the wireless VR user QoE is improved, and the storage, calculation and communication resource utilization rate is improved.

title: Edge gateway, edge computing system and configuration method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an edge gateway, an edge computing system and a configuration method thereof, and the edge gateway comprises a first interface which is used for connecting at least one intelligent terminal according to an IP address, controlling the intelligent terminal, and collecting the data of the intelligent terminal; a second interface which is used for connecting at least one non-intelligent terminal according to the IP address, wherein the edge gateway controls the non-intelligent terminal and collects analog data of the non-intelligent terminal; a third interface used for being connected with at least one edge computing server according to the IP address, wherein the edge gateway receives edge resource support of the edge computing server and sends edge data to the edge computing server for man-machine interaction; and a fourth interface used for being connected with the cloud according to the IP address, wherein the edge gateway receives edge resource support of the cloud and sends edge data to the edge computing server for man-machine interaction. A plurality of edge nodes are arranged, and different edge nodes are connected through the service interface, so that the edge calculation efficiency is improved.

title: Third-party-free logistic regression federated learning model training system and method
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a third-party-free logic regression federated learning model training system and method, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the system comprises a first device and a second device. The first device generates a public key and a private key, calculates a first inner product and sends the public key and a first encrypted inner product to the second device. The second device calculates a second inner product, encrypts the second inner product, calculates an encryption forward gradient and a second encryption gradient for a second model, and sends the encryption forward gradient and the masked second encryption gradient to the first device. The first device decrypts the encryption forward gradient and the second encryption gradient, sends the second gradient to the second device, calculates a first gradient, and adjusts the first model parameter according to the first gradient. The second device adjusts the second model parameter. By applying the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the process of model training can be completed while the security of sample data is ensured under the condition that no trusted third-party equipment exists.

title: Data processing method and device for federal learning model, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a data processing method and device for a federal learning model applied to first participant equipment. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a feature set as a training sample of the federated learning model wherein the feature set comprises features provided by a first participant with label information and features provided by at least one second participant; obtaining a plurality of feature subsets included in the feature set, and constructing model input of a federal learning model corresponding to each feature subset; inputting each constructed model input into a federated learning model to obtain a prediction result corresponding to each model input, and inputting the training sample into the federated learning model to obtain a target prediction result corresponding to the training sample; and determining contribution information of the target prediction result corresponding to each feature in the feature set based on each obtained prediction result and the target prediction result. According to the application, the contribution information of each feature in a single sample and the contribution information of the second participant can be accurately measured.

title: Resource scheduling method and device based on big data
abstract: The invention discloses a resource scheduling method based on big data. The method comprises the steps that a cloud server distributes a hotspot data group to a plurality of mobile edge nodes MEC; the plurality of MECs distribute the hotspot data group to a plurality of mobile terminals; the cloud server predicts key performance indicators (KPI) of the multiple MECs, if the predicted KPI of the first MEC does not meet a quality service (QoS) condition, the distribution operation of the first MEC is suspended, and a hotspot data set stored in the first MEC is subjected to data splitting to be split into multiple sub hotspot data sets; and the first MEC determines a similar MEC cluster having similar characteristics with the first MEC according to a similarity criterion, and sequentially distributes the plurality of sub-hotspot data groups to different MECs of the similar MEC cluster according to a load balancing strategy, so that the similar MEC cluster distributes the plurality of sub-hotspot data to a plurality of mobile terminals in sequence according to different routing paths.

title: Data set construction system and method for non-independent identically distributed federated learning
abstract: The invention provides a data set construction system and method for non-independent identically distributed federal learning. The system comprises an initial module, a selection module and a state sequence group extraction module, wherein the initial module is used for receiving a data set, and sampling according to an initial probability distribution matrix and an initial probability transfer matrix to generate an initial state sequence; the selection module is used for receiving the initial state sequence group and generating a data set for non-independent identically distributed federal learning; and the state sequence group extraction module is used for generating a state sequence group according to the received state sequence and the group number. According to the method, the real data set is divided into a plurality of smaller subsets to synthesize the distributed non-independent identically-distributed data set, different numbers of participants are easy to set, the balance of local data is convenient to quantify, and a non-independent identically-distributed scene is constructed for research and use.

title: Construction method of data communication mode of subway security check system
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method of a data communication mode of a subway security check system. The construction method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a picture information transmission mode between subsystems; S2, establishing a basic data synchronization mode; S3, establishing a communication mode between a centralized picture discrimination subsystem and a picture discrimination client by adopting Socket, the centralized picture discrimination subsystem inserting a distribution queue containing picture data into a queue to be discriminated to wait for scheduling, the picture data scheduling adopting a mode that the picture discrimination client actively pulls the picture data, and if the extracted picture data exceeds the specified time, asynchronously recording that the data state is overtime, and pulling the next picture data of the distribution queue again; and if the queue is empty, the picture judging client obtaining a response of no picture data. According to the invention, the timeliness and continuity of data interaction are ensured while the integrity of service data is ensured.

title: Application processing method and device
abstract: The invention provides an application processing method and device, and relates to the computer technology, in particular to the field of big data. According to the specific implementation scheme, an edge server receives an application operation instruction from a central server, and the application operation instruction comprises an identifier of a target application and an operation type for operating the target application. The edge server obtains a to-be-processed data packet corresponding to the target application according to the identifier of the target application. the edge server executes an operation corresponding to the operation type on the to-be-processed data packet corresponding to the target application according to the operation type. The application operation instruction is sent to the edge server through the central server, and then the edge server can obtain the to-be-processed data packet corresponding to the target application according to the identifier of the target application and execute the operation on the target application according to the operation type indicated by the application operation instruction. According to the method and the device, the application maintenance of each edge server is automatically realized, so that the maintenance efficiency of the application in the edge server is effectively improved.

title: Federal learning participant contribution measurement method, device, storage medium and equipment
abstract: The invention provides a federal learning participant contribution measurement method, a device, a storage medium and equipment, and relates to the technical field of machine learning. The method comprises the steps that the marginal contribution amount of each feature of each participant of a federated learning modeling task to a Shapril value of a federated learning model obtained through training is determined, and each feature is a feature provided by each participant and used for training a data set of the federated learning model; and determining the sum of the marginal contributions of the Shapley values of all the features of each participant, and obtaining the contribution of each participant to the federated learning model. According to the embodiment of the invention, the contribution value of each participant of federated learning to the federated learning model can be reflected more objectively, and the precision of evaluating the contribution value of the participant to the federated learning model is improved.

title: Service position acquisition device in edge computing system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of communication technology, in particular to a service position acquisition device in an edge computing system. The device comprises a device body, antennas and reinforcing mechanisms. Each reinforcing mechanism comprises a protective sleeve which is movably connected to the outer side of the antenna, and is used for protecting the antenna; a connecting through hole, wherein the antenna is movably connected to the inner side of the connecting through hole; and an empty groove which is formed in the inner side of the connecting through hole, wherein an elastic piece and an abutting piece are arranged on the inner side of the empty groove, and the abutting piece is movably connected to the outer side of the antenna. Through the arranged reinforcing mechanism, the antenna in a vertical state can be protected, so that the antenna is prevented from being broken due to collision; meanwhile, the antenna can be kept in the vertical state all the time and cannot fall down due to long-time placement, so that the device is made to be in the optimal receiving or sending state all the time, and the safety and performance of the device are improved.

title: Online action detection method and system for progressive privileged information distillation
abstract: The invention provides an online action detection method and system for progressive privileged information distillation, and the method comprises the steps: S1, carrying out the feature extraction of a video which is not cut through employing a video feature extraction network, and obtaining a video feature sequence capable of expressing video semantic information; s2, intercepting videos with different time lengths after the current moment, and training a plurality of different offline teacher models by using corresponding video feature sequences; s3, training an online student model by using the extracted video feature sequence to obtain a trained online student model; s4, performing feature alignment on the offline teacher model and the online student model among different levels of the model level; s5, after feature alignment, the online student model learns from a plurality of different offline teacher models in a progressive model distillation mode; and S6, predicting a result of action detection at the current moment by using the extracted video feature sequence according to the online student model after distillation learning.

title: Image generation method based on adaptive gradient cutting under differential privacy protection
abstract: The invention discloses an image generation method based on adaptive gradient cutting under differential privacy protection, and solves the problems of excessive noise and unreasonable cutting in a gradient cutting method based on training data in a conventional privacy protection-based model generation algorithm. Meanwhile, a cutting threshold distribution method based on a model layer gradient cutting method is improved, the efficiency of network learning is improved on the premise that the cutting threshold is reasonably distributed, and the magnitude of gradient noise added after cutting is further reduced under the condition that finer cutting granularity is selected. Therefore, the method can provide a more reasonable gradient cutting mode and lower noise addition. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the generation model can be more quickly converged to a local optimal solution under the conditions of more appropriate cutting and smaller noise addition, and the purpose of generating a high-quality picture is achieved.

title: Online learning method and device supporting operation and maintenance alarm, and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an online learning method and device supporting intelligent operation and maintenance alarm and a storage medium, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining input data of a first model and an output result corresponding to the input data, and if the output result generates an alarm, transmitting and caching the input data and the output result to a data collector; secondary judgment is carried out on the output result in the data collector, and if the output result is judged to generate a true alarm, the output result and the input data corresponding to the output result are transmitted and stored to a database; based on the input data in the database and the output result, updating the first model to generate a second model; and simultaneously operating the first model and the second model, and judging the optimization direction of the second model based on the first model. According to the method, online learning can be carried out based on the online data, the learning model precision is improved, and the problem of low model precision caused by insufficient training data can be solved.

title: Model training method based on differential privacy protection, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method based on differential privacy protection, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The model training method based on differential privacy protection comprises the steps of obtaining a composite convex minimization problem; a solution function is constructed for the composite convex minimization problem, and the solution function comprises a Laplacian smooth operator; initializing an original variable in a solution function; and performing loop iteration on the solution function according to an input preset number of iterations to obtain a final model parameter. According to the model training method provided by the invention, the convergence speed of the model parameter output with differential privacy protection for solving the target problem to the optimal solution of the model is improved through the Laplacian smoothing technology.

title: Resource scheduling method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a resource scheduling method and device, equipment and a storage medium. According to the specific scheme, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first query per second QPS of a to-be-predicted target business service in a preset first time period; according to the first QPS, determining a second QPS in a preset prediction time period by using a preset load prediction model; according to the second QPS, a first Pod number corresponding to the second QPS is determined by using a preset capacity model, and the preset capacity model is determined according to sample data training of the business service; and scheduling resources of the target business service according to the first Pod number and a preset resource use condition. According to the embodiment of the invention, resource scheduling can be more reasonable, simple and convenient, the resource scheduling efficiency is improved, and the overall resource utilization rate of the service is further improved.

title: Communication control method and device, base station and computer readable medium
abstract: The invention provides a communication control method, which comprises the following steps of: when a triggering condition for switching a rate matching mode of user equipment (UE) is met, determining a target rate matching mode of the UE according to a current first rate matching mode of the UE; and scheduling the UE based on the target rate matching mode. The invention further provides a communication control device, a base station and a computer readable medium.

title: CLOUD COMPUTING SYSTEM AND EDGE COMPUTING SYSTEM
abstract: To provide a technology capable of inhibiting increases in power consumption and cooling load, taking into consideration both terrestrial and space applications.SOLUTION: A cloud computing system 1 comprises: geostationary satellites 10 each equipped with a computer 11 and a cloud data center 12; a low Earth orbit satellite constellation 20 including a plurality of communication satellites 30; and a ground data center 90 deployed on the ground. In the low Earth orbit satellite constellation 20, each communication satellite 30 of the plurality of communication satellites 30 flying in the same orbital plane can communicate with the communication satellites 30 ahead and behind the same in the orbital direction, thereby forming a ring network 21, and in addition, the plurality of communication satellites 30 flying in the same orbital plane can communicate with the communication satellites 30 flying in an adjacent orbit, thereby forming a mesh network 22 in which adjacent ring networks 21 are communicably connected to one another.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: A METHOD OF CALCULATING A PRODUCTION VOLUME OF THE PRODUCTION LINE USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
abstract: Embodiments provide a method for calculating the amount of production of a production line using artificial intelligence. The method for calculating the amount of production of a production line using artificial intelligence according to the embodiment may include: a step in which an order information input unit receives order information including the order quantity of an order product and the production difficulty of the order product; a step in which by a production rate analyzer, daily production data of the production line is provided and production efficiency is output; a step in which by a production line information input unit, the work throughput and the production difficulty of the production line are provided; a step of outputting a unique production index based on the throughput and the production difficulty; a step in which a production line analyzer outputs an n-day cumulative production volume based on the production efficiency and the unique production index, wherein the n is a natural number; a step of determining, by a production scheduling unit, a maximum value N of the n at which the cumulative production volume on the n-day is equal to or smaller than the order quantity; and a step in which based on the cumulative production volume on day N and the cumulative production volume on day N+1, the optimal daily target production volume of the production line is output, wherein N is a natural number. The method of the present invention accurately predicts the optimal daily target production volume of a production line.

title: FEDERATED LEARNING DRIVING METHOD WITH SIGN-ALIGNMENT PRECODING USING BAYESIAN AIRCOMP OVER WIRELESS NETWORKS AND THE SYSTEM THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and system for driving federated learning over a wireless network, which proposes a federated learning algorithm with sign-alignment precoding using Bayesian AirComp (over-the-air computation).
