The method comprises the steps of: modeling, by a mobile device, a prior distribution as a Gaussian distribution to estimate a local gradient and compressing the local gradient; transmitting, by the mobile device, the compressed local gradient to the server using sign-alignment precoding; and calculating, by the server, the sum of local slopes for the local slopes using the Bayesian AirComp. The present invention can provide improved quality compared to the state-of-the-art one-bit broadband digital aggregation (OBDA) algorithm.

title: Techniques for deploying workloads on nodes in a cloud-computing environment
abstract: Described are examples for deploying workloads in a cloud-computing environment. In an aspect, based on a desired number of workloads of a process to be executed in a cloud-computing environment and based on one or more failure probabilities, an actual number of workloads of the process to execute in the cloud-computing environment to provide a level of service can be determined and deployed. In another aspect, a standby workload can be executed as a second instance of the process without at least a portion of the separate configuration used by the multiple workloads, and based on detecting termination of one of multiple workloads, the standby workload can be configured to execute based on the separate configuration of the separate instance of the process corresponding to the one of the multiple workloads.

title: Method, system, storage medium and application for joint optimization of resource allocation
abstract: A method for joint optimization of resource allocation includes: obtaining network data volumes of two services; obtaining queue statuses at a time t; computing sub-channel slices; computing a local CPU speed scaling, a user association, a sub-carrier assignment, and a power allocation of service 1; computing a user association, a video quality decision, and a sub-carrier assignment of service 2; obtaining an initial sub-carrier assignment and an initial power allocation; obtaining the user association; obtaining the power allocation and the sub-carrier assignment of service 1; obtaining the video quality decision; obtaining the sub-carrier assignment of service 2; obtaining an optimal data transmission rate and the user association to obtain a data rate allocation; and obtaining an optimal CPU speed scaling, an optimal user association, an optimal sub-carrier assignment, an optimal power allocation, an optimal video quality decision and an optimal sub-channel allocation.

title: Method and device for configuring SL HARQ RTT timer in NR V2X
abstract: Provided are a method for performing wireless communication by a first device, and a device for supporting same. The method may comprise: obtaining a sidelink (SL) discontinuous reception (DRX) configuration including a value of a SL DRX retransmission timer; receiving, from a second device through a physical sidelink control channel (PSCCH), first sidelink control information (SCI) for scheduling of second SCI and a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH); receiving, from the second device through the PSSCH, the second SCI and data; determining a value of a SL DRX hybrid automatic repeat request (HARD) round trip time (RTT) timer as zero, based on that information related to a next retransmission resource is not included in the first SCI; and starting the SL DRX retransmission timer.

title: Neural image compression with latent feature-domain intra-prediction
abstract: A method of decoding an image with latent feature-domain intra-prediction is performed by at least one processor and includes receiving a set of latent blocks and for each of the blocks in the set of latent blocks: predicting a block, based on a set of previously recovered blocks; receiving a selection signal indicating a currently recovered block, based on the selection signal performing one of (1) and (2): (1) generating a compact residual, a set of residual context parameters, a decoded residual, and generating a first decoded block; (2) generating a second decoded block, based on a compact representation block and a set of context parameters. The method further includes generating a set of recovered blocks comprising each of the currently recovered blocks; generating a recovered latent image by merging all the blocks in the set of recovered blocks; and decoding the recovered latent image, to obtain a reconstructed image.

title: Pure integer quantization method for lightweight neural network (LNN)
abstract: A pure integer quantization method for a lightweight neural network (LNN) is provided. The method includes the following steps: acquiring a maximum value of each pixel in each of the channels of the feature map of a current layer; dividing a value of each pixel in each of the channels of the feature map by a t-th power of the maximum value, t∈[0,1]; multiplying a weight in each of the channels by the maximum value of each pixel in each of the channels of the corresponding feature map; and convolving the processed feature map with the processed weight to acquire the feature map of a next layer. The algorithm is verified on SkyNet and MobileNet respectively, and lossless INT8 quantization on SkyNet and maximum quantization accuracy so far on MobileNetv2 are achieved.

title: ML model management in O-RAN
abstract: Apparatuses for non real-time (Non-RT) radio access network intelligence controller (RIC) and Near-RT RIC services for machine learning (ML) model management in an open radio access network (O-RAN) are disclosed. The services include ML model monitoring, getting and putting ML models from and to an AI-ML producer and an AI-ML consumer, and terminating the use of an ML mode. The ML model monitoring includes the AI-ML consumer sending monitoring data to the AI-ML producer and the AI-ML producer processing the monitoring data and taking actions based on the monitoring data. The services may be performed over the AI interface using HTTP.

title: Federated learning device interworking with mobile core system and method thereof
abstract: The present invention related to a method for federated learning method interworking with a mobile core system, the method comprising: querying terminal information of each individual terminal among a plurality of terminals; querying network performance information; selecting participating terminals among the plurality of terminals on the basis of the terminal information and the network performance information; transmitting respective parameters to the participating terminals and requesting local learning; and integrating the parameters.

title: Confidence generation using a neural network
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to generate one or more confidence values associated with one or more objects identified by one or more neural networks. In at least one embodiment, one or more confidence values associated with one or more objects identified by one or more neural networks are generated based on, for example, one or more neural network outputs.

title: Tool selection for feature map encoding vs regular video encoding
abstract: An apparatus for generating first encoded data and second encoded data. The apparatus comprises a determining unit for determining whether the apparatus generates encoded data including encoded data of a feature map based on a neural network. The apparatus also comprise an encoding unit for generating the first encoded data using a plurality of functions for encoding video data, in a case where the apparatus generates the first encoded data in a form of encoded video data not including the encoded data of the feature map. The encoding unit generates the encoded data of the feature map using a first part of the plurality of functions but not using a second part of the plurality of functions, in a case where the apparatus generates the second encoded data including the encoded data of the feature map.

title: METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR MACHINE LEARNING-GUIDED COMPILER OPTIMIZATIONS FOR REGISTER-BASED HARDWARE ARCHITECTURES
abstract: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed that perform machine learning-guided compiler optimizations for register-based hardware architectures. Examples disclosed herein include a non-transitory computer readable medium comprising instructions that, when executed, cause a machine to at least select a register-based compiler transformation to apply to source code at a current position in a search tree, determine whether the search tree is in need of pruning based on an output of a query to a machine learning (ML) model, in response to determining the search tree is in need of pruning, prune the search tree at the current position, in response to applying the selected register-based compiler transformation to the source code, generate a code variant, calculate a score associated with the source code at the current position in the search tree, and update parameters of the machine learning (ML) model to include the calculated score.

title: AUDIO SYSTEM FOR ARTIFICIAL REALITY APPLICATIONS
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an audio system for artificial reality applications. One or more transducers of the audio system output, in accordance with audio instructions, one or more ultrasonic pressure waves simulating a virtual audio source near an ear of a user of the headset. A controller of the audio system generates the audio instructions such that the one or more ultrasonic pressure waves form at least a portion of audio content for presentation to the user. An array of microphones of the audio system detects audio signals in a local area. A deep neural network of the audio system processes the detected audio signals to generate enhanced audio content, and the one or more transducers present the enhanced audio content to a user.

title: EXHAUSTIVE LEARNING TECHNIQUES FOR MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHMS
abstract: Techniques are disclosed relating to exhaustive learning techniques for machine learning algorithms. In various embodiments, the disclosed techniques include performing an iterative machine learning operation that includes training a first version of a machine learning model (e.g., a decision tree model) based on a current version of a training dataset, where the first version of the machine learning model includes a plurality of decision branches, identifying a first subset of data samples that satisfy evaluation criteria included in a first one of the plurality of decision branches, and removing this first subset of data samples to generate an updated version of the training dataset. In various embodiments, the disclosed techniques include repeating the iterative machine learning operation using the updated version of the training dataset to produce a final trained version of the machine learning model.

title: METHOD FOR DYNAMICALLY UPDATING A PROJECT PLAN USING AN AI MODEL AND HISTORICAL DATA
abstract: A method for dynamically updating a project plan using natural language processing (NLP) and artificial intelligence (AI) model is provided. The method includes, (i) obtaining master schedule that includes category of a work, and location of the work, and object being worked on, (ii) identifying similar works using the NLP to associate with work cycle, (iii) training AI model by correlating a historical data of changes in the project plan and reasons for the changes in the project plan, (iv) suggesting, using the NLP, applicable work sequence breakdown templates, (v) obtaining a selection of the applicable work sequence breakdown templates from user, (vi) updating the project plan based on selected work sequence breakdown template, (vii) dynamically updating the project plan across works associated with work cycle when there is a change to works, and (viii) dynamically updating the project plan using the NLP and trained AI model based on the change to works.

title: FEATURE DEPRECATION ARCHITECTURES FOR DECISION-TREE BASED METHODS
abstract: Various techniques for determining risk assessment predictions and decisions are disclosed. Certain disclosed techniques include the implementation of decision-tree based models in determining predictions of risk for an operation based on an input dataset. The disclosed techniques include pruning decision trees to compensate for deprecation of variables from the input dataset. Decision trees may be pruned at nodes associated with the deprecated variables to inhibit the decision trees from breaking down during operation on an input dataset having deprecated variables.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR GROUP QUALITY-OF-SERVICE CONTROL OF MULTIPLE QUALITY-OF-SERVICE FLOWS
abstract: A control entity for controlling a communication service of a mobile communication network includes a first communication interface configured to obtain a group quality of service (QoS) treatment requirement for group QoS treatment of a traffic group including one or more communication services in the mobile communication network. The control entity also includes a processor configured to generate one or more QoS flow groups and a corresponding group QoS treatment policy for each QoS flow group based on the obtained group QoS treatment requirement and the traffic group. Each QoS flow group includes at least one of the communication services. The control entity further includes a second communication interface configured to provide QoS group information to one or more network entities in the mobile communication network. The QoS group information includes a QoS flow group identifier and the group QoS treatment policy for a corresponding QoS flow group.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR ASSISTING AN AUTONOMOUS VEHICLE AND/OR A DRIVER OF A VEHICLE
abstract: An apparatus for assisting a control system and/or a driver of a vehicle is provided. The apparatus comprises a processing circuitry configured to: determine for a plurality of positions within a vicinity of the vehicle, based on motion state information of the vehicle, a respective first probability measure that the vehicle will be at the respective position at one or more future time instants; determine for the plurality of positions, based on motion state information of at least one traffic object, a respective second probability measure that the at least one traffic object will be at the respective position at the one or more future time instants; and determine for the plurality of positions, a respective combined probability measure that the vehicle and the at least one traffic object will be at the respective position at the one or more future time instants.

title: ACTIVATING TRANSMISSION CONFIGURATION INDICATOR CODEPOINTS
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive, from a base station, an indication that indicates whether a medium access control control element (MAC-CE)-based implicit transmission configuration indicator (TCI) update rule is enabled. The UE may receive, from the base station, a MAC-CE that activates one or more TCI codepoints based at least in part on the indication. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: SECURE COMPUTING SYSTEM, FINANCIAL INSTITUTION SERVER, INFORMATION PROCESSING SYSTEM, SECURE COMPUTING METHOD, AND RECORDING MEDIUM
abstract: A secure computing system according to the present disclosure is used to analyze financial transactions based on information regarding customer assets, and comprises: a parameter reception means that receives input of encrypted parameters of a plurality of models generated by each of a plurality of financial institutions; a secure computing means that integrates the plurality of encrypted parameters through secure computation; and an output means that outputs, in an encrypted format, the parameters integrated by the secure computing means.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING NETWORK SLICE INFORMATION IN WIRELESS COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a communication method and system for converging a 5th-Generation (5G) communication system for supporting higher data rates beyond a 4th-Generation (4G) system with a technology for Internet of Things (IoT). The present disclosure may be applied to intelligent services based on the 5G communication technology and the IoT-related technology, such as smart home, smart building, smart city, smart car, connected car, health care, digital education, smart retail, security and safety services.

title: "AUTOMATED CLASSIFICATION PIPELINE"
abstract: This disclosure relates to a computer system for classifying a product into a tariff classification, which is represented by a node in a tree of nodes. A data store stores the tree of nodes, each node being associated with a text string indicative of a semantic description of that node as a sub-class of a parent of that node, and multiple classification components, each having a product characterisation as input and a classification into one of the nodes as an output. A processor iteratively selects one of the multiple classification components based on a current classification of the product, and applies the one of the multiple classification components to the product characterisation to update the current classification of the product. The processor further outputs, responsive to meeting a termination condition, the current classification as a final classification of the product.

title: INSTANCE-ADAPTIVE IMAGE AND VIDEO COMPRESSION IN A NETWORK PARAMETER SUBSPACE USING MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEMS
abstract: Techniques are described for compressing data using machine learning systems. An example process can include receiving input data for compression by a neural network compression system. The process can include determining, based on the input data, a set of updated model parameters for the neural network compression system, wherein the set of updated model parameters is selected from a subspace of model parameters. The process can include generating at least one bitstream including a compressed version of the input data and a compressed version of one or more subspace coordinates that correspond to the set of updated model parameters. The process can include outputting the at least one bitstream for transmission to a receiver.

title: TASK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, METHOD AND APPARATUS, DEVICE, AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: The present application relates to a task management system, method and apparatus, a device, and a storage medium. The system comprises: an interface method layer, used for providing an interface connected to a human-computer interaction interface; a parsing layer, used for providing a workflow description language parser, and providing a task scheduling interface and a task storage interface; and an execution layer, used for calculating and storing resources, providing a task execution shell program to download and execute data of tasks to be executed, and uploading an execution result after the execution is completed. In embodiments of the present application, tasks are scheduled and stored by means of independent interfaces, so that multiple cloud computing platforms and cloud storage platforms can be arbitrarily docked, and thus the invocation and execution of the same task in a hybrid environment are implemented; by means of the design of the shell program, the granularity of task management is increased to a container layer, a difference in service tools of different cloud vendors in a hybrid cloud environment is shielded, and the containerization technology is adapted to the outer layer of a computing program. Thus, could computing resources can be effectively utilized, computational costs are reduced, and the amount of computation is reduced.

title: ORTHOGONAL FREQUENCY-DIVISION MULTIPLE ACCESS (OFDMA) SCHEDULE ALIGNMENT FOR MESH NETWORKING
abstract: A network device for aligning Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) schedules across nodes in a multi-hop network. An observed OFDMA repetitive schedule associated with a client device that repeatedly requests a grant to transmit traffic is obtained. A derived OFDMA repetitive schedule is determined for transmission of traffic by the client device. The derived OFDMA repetitive schedule may be determined by a network node coupled to the client device, a neighbor network device, an edge gateway, a system controller, etc. The network device may use the derived OFDMA repetitive schedule when it determines the derived OFDMA repetitive schedule itself, or it may receive the derived OFDMA repetitive schedule from another network device, such as a neighboring network device, an edge gateway, or a system controller.

title: CHIP, ACCELERATION CARD, ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND DATA PROCESSING METHOD
abstract: The embodiment of the present disclosure provides a chip, an acceleration card, an electronic device, a data processing method and apparatus, and a non-transitory computer readable storage medium. A control unit in the chip controls and schedules each sub-network of a neural network to be subjected to AI operation in a first processing unit; upon completion of first processing of one group of sub-networks, the control unit schedules network parameters of the next group of sub-networks to the first processing unit to carry out first processing of the next stage. Hence, streamlined processing is implemented among a plurality of groups of sub-networks included in the neural network realize, and the processing efficiency is further improved.

title: Calculation graph scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a computational graph scheduling method and device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target computational graph; dividing the first node set based on a dependency relationship among operator nodes to obtain a plurality of calculation layer groups; respectively generating a first duration corresponding to each second node set, and generating a second duration corresponding to each calculation layer group by using the first duration; if the second minimum duration is smaller than a third duration corresponding to the first node set, determining a second node set in the target calculation layer group as a new first node set; if the second minimum duration is not less than the third duration, judging whether a new first node set is generated by other node sets or not; if no other node set generates the new first node set, forming a scheduling result of the target calculation graph by using the first node set and the other node sets; according to the method, the calculation efficiency is kept relatively high, meanwhile, competition for calculation resources is avoided, and the resource utilization rate is balanced.

title: Dynamic station cargo handling method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic station cargo handling method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring pose information of a dynamic station by using a scanner arranged above a dynamic station area, and sending the pose information to a warehouse management module through the scanner; the warehouse management module generates a cargo handling task according to the pose information, and sends the cargo handling task to an AGV scheduling module; and the AGV scheduling module generates a task route according to the cargo handling task, and sends the task route to an idle AGV so as to schedule the AGV to complete a corresponding automatic loading and unloading task according to the cargo handling task. According to the basic scheme of the embodiment of the invention, automatic carrying of dynamic station goods is realized through the dynamic station detection module, the warehouse management module and the AGV scheduling module.

title: Federal learning-oriented data privacy security mechanism assessment method and device, and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of data privacy protection, and particularly discloses a federated learning-oriented data privacy security mechanism evaluation method and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: sampling a sample data set for training a local model, and obtaining an original sample; reconstructing a group of reconstructed samples related to the original sample through the reconstruction model; calculating a gradient difference between the original sample and the reconstructed sample, and iterating the reconstructed sample according to the gradient difference to obtain a final reconstructed sample; calculating the similarity and the matching rate of the final reconstruction sample and the original sample, and taking the similarity and the matching rate as monitoring values of the sample data set; comparing whether the monitoring value is greater than or equal to a preset value, and if yes, giving a gradient leakage risk alarm; otherwise, safety is prompted. According to the invention, the risk assessment index is formulated according to the similarity between the reconstructed sample and the input sample, and the method does not depend on a pre-trained statistical model.

title: Target category detection model training method, target detection method and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a training method of a target category detection model, a target detection method and electronic equipment, the training method comprises the following steps: obtaining at least two categories of sample images and labels thereof, the labels comprising the categories of the sample images; inputting the sample image into a teacher category detection model to obtain a prediction result so as to determine the difference between the prediction result and the label and the gradient of each parameter in the teacher category detection model; on the basis of the size relation among the difference, the gradient and the gradient threshold value and the first learning rate, parameters of the teacher category detection model are updated to determine a target teacher category detection model and a student category detection model, and the student category detection model is obtained after pruning processing is conducted on the target teacher category detection model; and training a student category detection model based on the sample image and a second learning rate, and determining a target category detection model, the first learning rate being greater than the second learning rate. The method can be operated on a terminal with low configuration, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title: Federal learning method, device and system for asynchronous mode training and readable medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of model training, in particular to a federated learning method, device and system for asynchronous mode training and a readable medium. The federated learning method for asynchronous mode training comprises the following steps: sending a to-be-trained model to a plurality of branch lines; the branch line comprises a plurality of available nodes; a plurality of available nodes in each branch line train the to-be-trained model in sequence to obtain a corresponding first pre-selected model; receiving a first pre-selected model fed back by each branch line, and performing aggregation processing to obtain a second pre-selected model; and judging whether the second pre-selected model reaches a termination condition, if so, terminating the training, and otherwise, carrying out the next round of training. The trained model comprises the data features of a plurality of nodes, the individual features are well hidden, the model to be trained is serially propagated and trained among the available nodes, the central end is difficult to restore the local data of the nodes, the problem that no credible central end exists is solved to a certain extent, and the data feature security of the individual nodes is improved.

title: Cloud computing resource allocation system and allocation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a cloud computing resource allocation system, which comprises a plurality of first-level cloud computing nodes, each first-level cloud computing node is provided with an independent computing unit and is used for processing a high-priority computing request; the computing unit of each secondary cloud computing node is in communication connection with the computing units of the other secondary cloud computing nodes, and the secondary cloud computing nodes are used for preprocessing the computing requests, endowing the computing requests with high priorities or low priorities and simultaneously processing the computing requests with the low priorities; the data caching node is in communication connection with the first-level cloud computing node and the second-level cloud computing node and is used for unloading and caching data in the computing process; and the computing node control unit is used for regulating and controlling data processing processes in the first-level cloud computing nodes and the second-level cloud computing nodes and regulating and controlling the levels of the cloud computing nodes at the same time. According to the method, the defects in the prior art can be overcome, the allocation strategy of the cloud computing resources is optimized, and the utilization rate of the cloud computing resources is increased.

title: Deep learning training inference system based on FPGA
abstract: The invention relates to a deep learning training inference system based on an FPGA. The deep learning training inference system comprises a cloud training device, a sensor device, a result comprehensive display device and an edge training inference device. The cloud training equipment, the sensor equipment and the result comprehensive display equipment are respectively connected with the edge end training reasoning equipment; the cloud training equipment is used for acquiring initial training parameters and transmitting the initial training parameters to the edge end training reasoning equipment; the sensor equipment is used for collecting data and transmitting the collected data to the edge end training reasoning equipment; the edge end training reasoning equipment performs reasoning and online training on the received initial training parameters and data; and the updated training parameters and reasoning results are output to a result comprehensive display device. The method has the advantages that high-speed and high-efficiency reasoning can be realized, the training requirement of edge end online learning can be met, meanwhile, the ability of reasoning training is achieved, and the method has the advantages of being completely autonomous, controllable, capable of being developed in a customized mode, low in power consumption and the like.

title: Parallel cloud workflow scheduling method based on evolutionary reinforcement learning strategy
abstract: The invention discloses a parallel cloud workflow scheduling method based on an evolutionary reinforcement learning strategy, and the method comprises the steps: employing two populations to optimize the execution time and cost of a workflow, designing the individuals of the populations as reinforcement learning agents, and achieving the optimization of the workflow through the interactive learning of the agents and the environment and the network parameter updating based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm. Two-stage optimization of the intelligent agent network is realized; in the reinforcement learning model training process, abundant and diversified action selection experience sequences are generated through parallel interaction and iterative learning between multiple agents in a population and the environment, and the search diversity is improved; meanwhile, a complementary heuristic mechanism is designed, and the action selection probability of the Agent is finely adjusted and corrected by utilizing external target advantage information of a scheduling scheme, so that optimization between workflow execution time and cost is better balanced, and the global search capability is improved.

title: Airport refueling dispatching device
abstract: The invention discloses an airport refueling dispatching device, relates to the technical field of resource management scheduling, and can solve the problems that a refueling task cannot be predicted and integral optimization dispatching cannot be performed on the refueling task within a period of time. The device comprises an input module, a refueling task library construction module, a directed graph construction module, a task string calculation module and a task string distribution module. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a refueling task library in a mode of predicting refueling tasks through modeling, taking the tasks as vertexes of a directed graph, making directed edges according to constraint conditions, constructing the directed graph, and converting the directed graph into a task matrix; solving a solution of a task optimal allocation problem through matrix calculation; in the matrix calculation process, a higher weight is given to the directed edge appearing in the directed graph, so that the probability of becoming the optimal directed edge is increased. According to the device, a complex airport refueling dispatching problem is converted into a graph calculation problem, the calculation amount is small, the application range is wide, and popularization is easy.

title: Federal active learning model training method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a federated active learning model training method and system, federated learning and active learning are combined together, a large amount of unlabeled data of each participant can be fully utilized to carry out model cooperative training on the premise of protecting data privacy, and in each federated learning training round, the training efficiency is greatly improved. The global model obtained by federal learning is utilized to guide local data labeling, the labeling efficiency is improved, and the problem of data islands is solved to a certain extent. A hybrid sampling strategy is provided based on loss prediction and feature space distance for active learning of information sample selection, high-quality samples can be selected, and the marking cost is reduced; and the precision and generalization performance of the model are improved by reducing the sample labeling cost.

title: Model training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a model training method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The model training method comprises the following steps: acquiring original image data to be trained, and acquiring original training parameters of an original model sent by a server side; performing label prediction on the original image data through the original model to obtain a prediction label, and performing feature extraction on the original image data through the original model to obtain a preliminary image feature; performing projection clustering processing on the preliminary image features to obtain a domain label and a domain combination label; calculating a distance loss function according to the domain label and the domain combination label; updating the first and second original network parameters according to a preset cross entropy loss function and a distance loss function to obtain first and second target parameters; and sending the first target parameter and the second target parameter to a server side, so that the server side updates the original model to obtain a global model. According to the embodiment of the invention, model training is carried out based on federated learning, so that the model training efficiency and accuracy can be improved.

title: Automatic scheduling generation method based on polyhedral model
abstract: The invention provides an automatic scheduling generation method based on a polyhedral model, and relates to the fields of computers, compilers and the like. According to the method, the instance set and the dependency relationship of the polyhedral model described by operator calculation are used as input, the state is automatically scheduled, the process of generating the scheduling tree is a recursive process, and various optimization operations can be carried out in each step; according to the method, the earnings of scheduling optimization operations are predicted by using a machine learning model, and the logarithm sum of the earnings predicted by the optimization operations is used as a prediction result of the scheduling earnings; and selecting the optimal scheduling according to the predicted scheduling income, and outputting the scheduling of the polyhedral model in the form of the scheduling tree for back-end code generation. The machine learning model used by the method only needs to be pre-trained, can be suitable for different operators, is irrelevant to a calculation mode, does not need to be adjusted again in an actual compiling period, can shorten the compiling time, and is suitable for a scene where a scheduling optimization target is difficult to define or a plurality of scheduling optimization targets exist.

title: Quantitative evaluation method for training efficiency and personalized effect of personalized federal learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of personalized federated learning, and particularly relates to a personalized federated learning training efficiency and personalized effect quantitative evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: S1, creating a Non-IID cross-domain data set as an evaluation data set; s2, selecting a proper model as an initial global model of personalized federal learning; s3, global neural network training of federal learning is carried out, and a convergent global neural network model is aggregated; s4, each client uses a local data set to optimize and converge the issued global model, and forms a personalized local neural network model; according to the method, the cross-domain heterogeneous scene is fully considered, the personalized function of the model is realized, qualitative and quantitative evaluation indexes are given for the personalized federal learning training efficiency and the personalized effect on the basis of the existing research, and the personalized federal learning training efficiency and the personalized effect can be effectively improved in the cross-domain heterogeneous scene. A specific method is provided for measuring different personalized federal learning algorithms and architectures.

title: Computing resource allocation method and device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a computing resource allocation method and device, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-processed computing task and channel information between each computing node in a computing node set and a main node, and splitting the computing task into a plurality of subtasks; constructing a comprehensive efficiency function including the rate and the energy consumption cost of the computational nodes; according to the plurality of subtasks and the channel information of each computing node in the computing node set and the main node, optimizing the comprehensive efficiency function by taking the maximum function value of the comprehensive efficiency function as a target, so as to obtain a target computing node in the computing node set and the rate of the target computing node in the optimization process; and based on the rate of the target computing node, distributing the task data corresponding to the plurality of sub-tasks to the target computing node, so that the target computing node computes the task data corresponding to the plurality of sub-tasks, and returns a computing result. The computing resource allocation is more reasonable, and the computing benefit is higher.

title: Resource determination method and device, resource configuration method and device, communication device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a resource determination method and device, a resource configuration method and device, a communication device and a storage medium, and the resource determination method comprises the steps: determining a frequency domain resource except a first uplink sub-band in frequency domain resources corresponding to a downlink time slot as a first downlink frequency domain resource; and regarding the first downlink frequency domain resource as a continuous virtual frequency domain resource, and determining a frequency domain resource corresponding to a physical downlink shared channel in the virtual frequency domain resource according to downlink control information. According to the method and the device, even if the first downlink frequency domain resource except the UL subband in the frequency domain resource corresponding to the DL slot is not continuous, the first downlink frequency domain resource can be regarded as the continuous virtual frequency domain resource, so that the frequency domain resource occupied by the PDSCH is indicated on the continuous virtual frequency domain resource no matter whether the RA Type 1 is adopted to schedule the PDSCH or the RA Type 0 is adopted to schedule the PDSCH. Therefore, even if the RA Type 1 is adopted to schedule the PDSCH, there is no problem, and there is no need to limit the scheduling of the PDSCH by only adopting the RA Type 0, thereby being beneficial to saving overhead.

title: Financial enterprise digital transformation effect evaluation system based on federal learning
abstract: The invention discloses an enterprise digital transformation effect evaluation system based on federated learning, which relates to data preprocessing, federated learning model training and digital transformation effect evaluation, and comprises a data preprocessing module, a federated learning model training module and a digital transformation effect evaluation module. The data preprocessing module carries out preprocessing operations such as data cleaning and numerical value standardization on enterprise data; the federal learning training and model building module is used for training the private data of the enterprise through a training model under the condition of protecting the private data of the enterprise from being leaked; and the evaluation module is used for evaluating the digital transformation current situation of the enterprise, evaluating the digital transformation degree of the enterprise according to the constructed evaluation system, and providing a basis for the digital transformation scheme of the enterprise. According to the method, enterprise data are protected through privacy calculation, and meanwhile, the enterprises can be helped to quickly and carefully analyze the digital transformation current situation of the enterprises.

title: Task execution method and heterogeneous server
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a task execution method and a heterogeneous server, and belongs to the technical field of heterogeneous computing. The method is applied to the heterogeneous server, the heterogeneous server comprises a central processing unit and a plurality of processing cards, and the method comprises the steps that the central processing unit determines the calculated amount corresponding to a task based on task information corresponding to the task to be distributed; obtaining available processing resources corresponding to each processing card; allocating the processing cards to the tasks based on the available processing resources corresponding to each processing card and the calculated amount corresponding to the tasks; and then sending the task to the allocated processing card for execution. By adopting the method and the device, the task execution efficiency of the heterogeneous server can be improved.

title: SERVICE PROCESSING METHOD, APPARATUS, COMMUNICATION DEVICE AND READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: This application discloses a service processing method and apparatus, a communication device, and a readable storage medium. The service processing method in embodiments of this application includes: obtaining, by a first communication device, coordination configuration information; and performing a first operation based on the coordination configuration information; where the coordination configuration information includes at least one of the following: coordination configuration information of a first tunnel, coordination configuration information of a second tunnel, and coordination configuration information of a first tunnel group; the coordination configuration information of the first tunnel includes at least one of the following: an identifier of the first tunnel, a QoS parameter of the first tunnel, information of the second tunnel, first indication information, and a time difference interval for approximate time scheduling; and the first operation includes at least one of the following: determining a radio bearer for a tunnel; determining an association relationship of a radio bearer; performing approximate time scheduling on data in an associated radio bearer; and requesting approximate time scheduling on data in an associated radio bearer.

title: MACHINE LEARNING-BASED OPTIMIZATION IN WIRELESS COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
abstract: The present specification relates to machine learning (ML)-based optimization. A method carried out by a first network node in a wireless communication system, according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, comprises the steps of: receiving, from a second network node, a first message including capability information indicating whether the second network node is capable of supporting a ML model; on the basis that the capability information indicates that the second network node is capable of supporting the ML model, transmitting, to the second network node, a second message for requesting for input data for model processing generated by the ML model; receiving the input data from the second network node; carrying out the model processing on the basis of at least one among the input data received from the second network node or a measurement result received from a user equipment (UE); acquiring output data inferred from the model processing; and carrying out one or more operations on the basis of the output data.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE USED IN WIRELESS COMMUNICATION NODE
abstract: The present application discloses a method and device used in a wireless communication node. The method comprises: a first node receives a first message set and first DCI; executes measurement on a first RS resource group; and sends first CSI on a PUSCH of a first cell. The first message set comprises a first message. The first DCI comprises a first field and a second field. The first DCI is used for scheduling PUSCHs on at least K cells, and K is a positive integer greater than 1. The first cell is one of the K cells. The first field of the first DCI is used for triggering the first CSI. The second field of the first DCI is used for determining the first cell. The measurement executed on the first RS resource group is used for calculating the first CSI. The first message is used to indicate the first RS resource group. According to the method, flexibility is increased, signaling overhead is reduced, and the reliability of CSI transmission is optimized.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS USED IN NODE FOR WIRELESS COMMUNICATION
abstract: The present application discloses a method and apparatus used in a node for wireless communication. A first node receives a first information set and first signaling, quits transmitting a first signal in a first time-frequency resource block, and transmits a second signal in a second time-frequency resource block or quits transmitting the second signal in the second time-frequency resource block. The first information set is used for determining the first time-frequency resource block and the second time-frequency resource block; the first signaling is used for determining a third time-frequency resource block; every two of the first time-frequency resource block, the second time-frequency resource block, and the third time-frequency resource block overlap in a time domain; a first reference signal resource group is used for determining a transmitting antenna port of the first signal, and a second reference signal resource group is used for determining a transmitting antenna port of the second signal; whether to quit transmitting the second signal in the second time-frequency resource block depends on the first information set. The method improves the uplink transmission efficiency, and also ensures the reliability of uplink transmission.

title: RESOURCE DETERMINATION METHODS AND APPARATUSES, AND COMMUNICATION APPARATUS AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of communications, in particular to resource determination methods and apparatuses, and a communication apparatus and a storage medium. A resource determination method comprises: determining a time domain unit where a subband for a first transmission direction is located, and determining a second transmission direction of the time domain unit; and according to the second transmission direction and the first transmission direction, determining a frequency domain resource that can be used to perform communication in the first transmission direction in the time domain unit. According to the present disclosure, a terminal can determine, according to a second transmission direction and a first transmission direction, a frequency domain resource that can be used to perform communication in the first transmission direction in a time domain unit, such that the communication in the first transmission direction is not limited to be performed only in a subband for the first transmission direction. On this basis, a frequency domain resource corresponding to a time domain unit where the subband for the first transmission direction is located can be fully utilized, thereby falicitating improvement to the scheduling flexibility and communication efficiency.

title: Content based log retrieval by using embedding feature extraction
abstract: Methods and systems for managing data processing systems are disclosed. A data processing system may include hardware and/or software components. The operation of the data processing system may depend on the operation of these components. To manage the operation of the data processing system, a system may include a data processing system manager. The data processing system manager may obtain logs for components of the data processing system reflecting the historical operation of these components and use the log to predict the future operation of the data processing system, identify similar operation of other data processing systems, and/or for other purposes. Based on the predictions, the data processing system manager may take action to reduce the likelihood of the data processing system becoming impaired.

title: Optimization of Virtual Warehouse Computing Resource Allocation
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for optimizing the configuration of virtual warehouses for execution of queries on one or more data warehouses are described herein. A plurality of different events associated with a data sharing platform may be logged. The data sharing platform may enable users to access one or more databases managed by the data sharing platform. The data sharing platform may be configured to provide access to the data stored by the data sharing platform via one or more of a plurality of virtual warehouses. A testing database may be generated. An optimized virtual warehouse configuration may be predicted for a first virtual warehouse by selecting a plurality of different warehouse configurations for the first virtual warehouse, measuring performance parameters of each of the plurality of different warehouse configurations by emulating, and selecting the optimized virtual warehouse configuration based on the performance parameters.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF PDCCH SKIPPING AND SCHEDULING REQUEST
abstract: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. The present disclosure provides method and apparatus for physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) monitoring. The method comprises receiving, from a base station, downlink control information (DCI) including an indication indicating skipping of PDCCH monitoring for a duration; in case that a scheduling request (SR) is triggered and not canceled, identifying whether the SR is triggered for a buffer status report (BSR); determining at least one serving cell, based on the identified result; and cancelling the skipping of PDCCH monitoring on the at least one serving cell.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR TIME-SERIES CLASSIFICATION USING RESERVOIR-BASED SPIKING NEURAL NETWORK
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods and systems for time-series classification using a reservoir-based spiking neural network, that can be used at edge computing applications. Conventional reservoir based SNN techniques addressed either by using non-bio-plausible backpropagation-based mechanisms, or by optimizing the network weight parameters. The present disclosure solves the technical problems of TSC, using a reservoir-based spiking neural network. According to the present disclosure, the time-series data is encoded first using a spiking encoder. Then the spiking reservoir is used to extract the spatio-temporal features for the time-series data. Lastly, the extracted spatio-temporal features of the time-series data is used to train a classifier to obtain the time-series classification model that is used to classify the time-series data in real-time, received from edge devices present at the edge computing network.

title: METHOD, SYSTEM, AND APPARATUS FOR EFFICIENT NEURAL DATA COMPRESSION FOR MACHINE TYPE COMMUNICATIONS VIA KNOWLEDGE DISTILLATION
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for managing sensor data, including receiving encoded data at a first device from a second device separate from the first device, wherein the encoded data is generated using an artificial intelligence (AI) encoder model included in the second device based on sensor data collected by at least one sensor included in the second device; providing the encoded data to an AI inference model to obtain inference information; and performing a task based on the inference information, wherein the AI encoder model and the AI inference model are jointly trained based on an output of an AI teacher model

title: PRE-EMPTIVE SCHEDULING OF WORKLOADS TO ENABLE IMPROVED SHARING OF RESOURCES
abstract: A pre-emptive scheduling of workloads enables improved sharing of resources of a cluster of hosts. The steps of this pre-emptive scheduling method include: adjusting priority of active workloads that are each running on one of the nodes and idle workloads that have been suspended; determining that a priority of a first workload, which is one of the idle workloads, exceeds a priority of a second workload, which is one of the active workloads and is executing on a first node of the cluster of nodes; and suspending the second workload and resuming the first workload to run on the first node.

title: GROUP HANDOVER CONFIGURATIONS
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive a group discontinuous reception (DRX) configuration. The UE may receive, based on the group DRX configuration, a notification communication indicative of group handover information associated with a group of UEs that includes the UE. The UE may perform, based on the group handover information, a group handover operation between a source cell and a target cell. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: FORTIFIED BACKUP OF ANOMALY DETECTION
abstract: An indication to perform a backup of data stored in a persistent storage associated with a source system is received. In response to the indication to perform the backup, current execution information at least in part maintained in a volatile memory is captured. The captured current execution information is caused to be stored with backup data from the backup of the data stored in the persistent storage

title: DYNAMIC SPLIT COMPUTING FRAMEWORK IN SERVERLESS EDGE COMPUTING
abstract: Disclosed is a split computing device operating in a serverless edge computing environment. The split computing device includes a transceiver configured to receive resource information of a terminal from the terminal and to measure a data transmission rate between the terminal and the split computing device in a process of receiving the resource information of the terminal; and a splitting point deriver configured to determine a splitting point of a deep neural network (DNN) model for split computing and an activation status of a container instance for each of tail models of a DNN corresponding to the respective splitting points using the resource information of the terminal, the data transmission rate, and resource information of the split computing device.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM OF SPECIAL VEHICLE NOTIFICATION IN HD MAP TO IMPROVE AV DRIVING SAFETY
abstract: System and methods for systems for special vehicle detection and notifications. Connected vehicle probe and sensor data is acquired and processed to detect the presence of a special vehicle using one or more machine learning models. Attributes are determined for the special vehicle based on additional information. An informational message/notification is composed and sent to vehicles in the vicinity of the special vehicle. Warnings may be provided for how to maneuver vehicles around the special vehicle.

title: REPLACE SYSTEM AND REPLACE METHOD
abstract: An AI/big-data processing module identifies, for each of a plurality of replacement patterns, based on an actual result value of a resource usage status, a leveling index value in a case in which at least one application has been replaced onto another execution platform. A policy manager module determines, based on the leveling index value identified for each of the plurality of replacement patterns, a replacement pattern relating to replacement to be executed. A life cycle management module, a container management module, and a configuration management module replace at least one application based on the determined replacement pattern.

title: GLOBAL PHASE TRACKING AND PREDICTING METHOD SUITABLE FOR TWIN-FIELD QUANTUM KEY DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM
abstract: A global phase tracking and predicting method suitable for a twin-field quantum key distribution system is provided. A time-aware sequence to sequence network (S2S) specially mounted on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA) is designed. In the global phase tracking and predicting method, global phase changes at a plurality of subsequent time points are tracked and predicted according to two-phase scan count and external environmental parameters acquired in real time, and the tracking and prediction results are then used to compensate phase disturbance in real time, thereby ensuring long-time global phase stability.

title: DATA PROCESSING METHOD AND DATA PROCESSING DEVICE USING SUPPLEMENTED NEURAL NETWORK QUANTIZATION OPERATION
abstract: A data processing method for neural network quantization, includes: obtaining a quantized weight by quantizing a weight of a neural network; obtaining a quantization error that is a difference between the weight and the quantized weight; obtaining input data with respect to the neural network; obtaining a first convolution result by performing convolution on the quantized weight and the input data; obtaining a second convolution result by performing convolution on the quantization error and the input data; obtaining a scaled second convolution result by scaling the second convolution result based on bit shifting; and obtaining output data by using the first convolution result and the scaled second convolution result.

title: CHECKPOINT STATE STORAGE FOR MACHINE-LEARNING MODEL TRAINING
abstract: A method for training a machine-learning model. A plurality of nodes are assigned for training the machine-learning model. Nodes include agents comprising at least an agent processing unit and local memory. Each agent manages, via a local network, one or more workers that include a worker processing unit. Shards of a training data set are distributed for parallel processing by workers at different nodes. Each worker processing unit is configured to iteratively train on minibatches of a shard, and to report checkpoint states indicating updated parameters for storage in local memory. Based at least on recognizing a worker processing unit failing, the failed worker processing unit is reassigned and initialized based at least on a checkpoint state stored in local memory.

title: ONLINE LEARNING METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR AI MODEL, AND COMMUNICATION DEVICE AND READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: The present application discloses an online learning method and apparatus for an artificial intelligence (AI) model, and a communication device and a readable storage medium. The online learning method for the AI model of embodiments of the present application comprises: a second device configures a first AI model for a first device; and the second device configures online learning information of the first AI model for the first device.

title: TERMINAL, COMMUNICATION METHOD, AND RADIO COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
abstract: A terminal includes a receiver that receives a first downlink signal from the first base station and a second downlink signal from the second base station; a transmitter that transmits a first uplink signal to the first base station and a second uplink signal to the second base station; and a processor that establishes a downlink connection with the first base station and an uplink connection with the second base station, in response to detecting a UL-DL imbalance, wherein, upon detecting that an instruction signal from the second base station is received, the processor changes the uplink connection with the second base station to an uplink connection with the second base station via a relay device.

title: A FLEXIBLE SUBBAND CONFIGURATION AND USE METHOD AND DEVICE
abstract: System, methods and apparatuses for flexible subband configuration can include a wireless communication node determining a configuration for flexible subband resources in frequency domain in one carrier or cell. The wireless communication node can send to a wireless communication device, the configuration. The configuration can indicate a time-frequency domain pattern of the flexible subband resources, the flexible subband resources comprising frequency domain resources in a plurality of symbols of at least one type of symbols.

title: DATA PROCESSING DEVICE, DATA PROCESSING SYSTEM, DATA PROCESSING METHOD, AND NON-TRANSITORY COMPUTER-READABLE MEDIUM HAVING PROGRAM STORED THEREIN
abstract: Provided is a data processing device which simply and suitably contributes to marketing activities. In a data processing device (110), an input unit (111) receives input data relating to prescribed consumption behavior. A federated learning model (112) is generated such that at least some local learning models generated for each of a plurality of different businesses are federated. The federated learning model (112) is generated by learning relationships between a plurality of customer groups generated from business customer data possessed by a business, and consumption behavior corresponding to the business. The federated learning model (112) is configured to be able to output potential customer data with respect to input data. An output unit (113) outputs the potential customer data.

title: MULTI-QUERY SCHEDULER-BASED MULTI-QUERY PROCESSING METHOD, AND DATA PROCESSING SYSTEM FOR IMPLEMENTING SAME METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a multi-query scheduler-based multi-query processing method, and a data processing system for implementing the method. The multi-query scheduler-based multi-query processing method may comprise the steps in which: a data processing system receives a multi-query input; and a multi-query scheduler of the data processing system determines the processing order of a plurality of queries included in the multi-query input.

title: KUBERNETES INTEGRATED CHARGEBACK AND LIMITS MANAGEMENT
abstract: Systems and methods for tracking resource usage on a network computing platform such as Kubemetes. A method includes establishing a resource allotment for a time period for a customer utilizing a network computing platform. The method includes receiving a custom callback from a webhook associated with the network computing platform, wherein the custom callback indicates the customer seeks to perform an action on the network computing platform. The method includes calculating a resource requirement for the action, calculating an up-to-date resource usage for the customer for the time period, and approving or denying the action based on whether the customer comprises sufficient remaining resources for the time period.

title: RESOURCE SCHEDULING METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR SATELLITE ELASTIC INTERNET, COMPUTER DEVICE, AND MEDIUM
abstract: The present disclosure provides a resource scheduling method and system for a satellite elastic Internet, a computer device, and a medium. A delay-sensitive satellite elastic Internet architecture is established based on a many-to-many mode between a low earth orbit (LEO) satellite and a client; after a satellite elastic Internet resource scheduling model is established based on the delay-sensitive satellite elastic Internet architecture, a minimum delay optimization model is established based on the satellite elastic Internet resource scheduling model, and the minimum delay optimization model is converted into a corresponding Markov decision model; and the Markov decision model is solved to obtain a resource scheduling strategy. This method can fully utilize computing and storage resources of a satellite, avoid affecting queuing delay performance, meet diverse needs of a client, improve QoS, and improve, based on a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm, computation efficiency of resource scheduling, thereby achieving service-prioritized, low-delay and load-balanced resource scheduling. This method has a strong generalization capability and high practical value.

title: Retina OCT image lesion classification method based on unsupervised heterogeneous distillation framework
abstract: The invention relates to a retina OCT image lesion classification method based on an unsupervised heterogeneous distillation framework, and belongs to the technical field of image classification. The method comprises a teacher network and a student network, the teacher network takes parameters pre-trained on a natural image as initial parameters of the teacher network, only a small number of normal retina OCT images are needed when the method is trained, the teacher network does not update the parameters during training, and the student network takes characteristics of the teacher network as input and does not update the parameters during training. In the test stage, whether the to-be-tested image is a lesion image is judged by comparing the difference of the features generated by the teacher network and the student network, so that the problem that a large number of medical image annotations are needed for training the deep learning network can be effectively relieved.

title: Calculation unloading method based on improved coral reef algorithm in cloud-edge cooperative calculation
abstract: The invention discloses a calculation unloading method based on an improved coral reef algorithm in cloud-edge cooperative calculation. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, modeling a task set and variables, an edge server set and variables, and a cloud server set and variables; determining a task unloading variable and a corresponding unloading matrix model of a task and a server; determining a system total time delay and load balancing index model; converting a multi-objective optimization problem of the total time delay and the load balancing index of the system into a single-objective optimization problem by utilizing a linear weighting mode, and determining an optimization objective of task unloading; and finally, solving an optimal task unloading strategy based on the minimum system time delay and the load balancing level by adopting an improved coral reef algorithm. According to the method, a system load imbalance phenomenon is avoided; a multi-objective optimization problem of task unloading can be resolved into a single-objective optimization problem; through a coral reef optimization algorithm of a hybrid genetic algorithm, the problems of iteration stagnation and local optimization of a standard coral reef algorithm are avoided, so that a globally optimal solution is obtained.

title: Machine resource recovery method, device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a machine resource recovery method and device, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the current state information of each allocated machine resource; judging whether the current state information of each allocated machine resource meets a recovery condition or not, and if yes, determining the allocated machine resources as machine resources to be recovered; and recycling the to-be-recycled machine resources. According to the method, the judgment accuracy of the recycled machine resources is improved, so that the situation that some unused machine resources are recycled to cause interruption of services operated by the machine resources, or the machine resources are idle to cause waste of the machine resources due to the fact that the machine resources are not recycled for a long time after being used is avoided, and the service quality of the machine resources is improved. And the workload of a machine resource scheduler is also reduced. In addition, according to the method, the phenomenon that machine resources are frequently increased or decreased is avoided, and the cost is greatly reduced.

title: Distributed blocking flow shop scheduling optimization system based on coevolution algorithm
abstract: The invention provides a distributed blocking flow shop scheduling optimization system based on a coevolution algorithm, and designs a coevolution algorithm assisted by a knowledge-driven cross-regional interactive learning mechanism to optimize distributed blocking flow shop scheduling under an energy consumption constraint condition. In order to reduce energy consumption and total delay in the production process, a heuristic method based on problem characteristics is designed. In order to improve the diversity and convergence rate of the population, a cross-regional interactive learning mechanism guided by an optimal state value function of reinforcement learning is designed, comprehensive collaboration is realized from an algorithm level, a parameter level and an individual level, and the solving precision and efficiency are improved. In order to improve the quality of solutions, an inferior solution repairing strategy and an individual body regeneration mechanism are provided. In addition, energy consumption is reduced by an energy saving operation on critical paths. Through comparison and verification on a continuous optimization problem test set and an instance composed of different factory numbers, workpiece numbers and machine numbers, the optimization effect of the optimization system designed by the invention is superior to that of other optimization systems.

title: Federal learning-based model training method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a model training method and device based on federated learning, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method is applied to a model training system, the model training system comprises a plurality of initial computing devices, initial models are stored in the plurality of initial computing devices, and the method comprises the steps that the initial computing devices perform federal training on the initial models according to preset training times to obtain the initial models; acquiring equipment index data and model parameter sending times of the initial computing equipment; constructing an equipment relation graph according to the equipment index data and the model parameter sending times; determining neighbor equipment of the initial computing equipment according to the equipment index data and the equipment relation graph; acquiring neighbor model parameters of neighbor equipment; and the initial computing device performs parameter adjustment on the initial model according to the neighbor model parameters to obtain a target model. According to the embodiment of the invention, the model training efficiency of the terminal can be improved.

title: Federal learning method and federal learning system
abstract: The invention discloses a federal learning method and a federal learning system. The learning method comprises the following steps: initialization: initializing global model parameters; distributing: distributing part or all of the global model parameters to edge equipment; parameter training: carrying out pre-training on global model parameters; updating and uploading: the server downloads a part of remaining global model parameters, issues the global model parameters to the edge device for parameter training, uploads a part of model parameter updates in advance, and uploads a final model parameter update when training is completed; aggregation: carrying out weighted average on all model parameters, and aggregating into a new model; and the steps of initialization, distribution, parameter training, updating and uploading and aggregation are repeatedly and sequentially executed on the new model. Through the federated learning method, part of the trained model parameters are uploaded in the training stage of the edge device, the uploading data size of the edge device after the whole model training is completed can be reduced, and therefore the time for the edge device to upload the model parameters is shortened.

title: Video transcoding system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of digital factories, in particular to a video transcoding system which comprises an access service and further comprises an analysis service, a management service and a streaming media service, monitoring videos of cameras are successfully uploaded to a twin scene, and synchronization of a virtual scene and a real monitoring picture is achieved. Camera differences are shielded, and unified RTSP video streams and HTTP operation interfaces are internally provided; the server is a master control service of each service cluster and is responsible for task scheduling and load balancing control; the camera is managed, and various operations on the camera are supported. The streaming media service is used for forwarding a video stream of a camera, outputting a WebSocket video stream or video streams in other formats, and supporting cross-platform playing of a web end; the problem that an operator needs to increase extra time to learn how to operate the type of manufacturer players is avoided, and the operation efficiency of players of different types of manufacturers is improved.

title: Urban visual landscape evaluation method and system based on structural equation model
abstract: The invention discloses an urban visual landscape evaluation method and system based on a structural equation model, and belongs to the field of urban planning. The evaluation method comprises the following steps: crawling urban visual landscape pictures and attached information, cleaning data, and establishing an urban visual landscape picture data set; quantifying urban visual landscape elements based on a deep convolutional neural network, and performing semantic segmentation on the urban visual landscape pictures in the data set to obtain urban visual landscape element indexes; judging the relationship between the quantized urban visual landscape element indexes and the landscape features, performing induction and classification on the quantized urban visual landscape element indexes and the landscape features through factor analysis of SPSS software, and finding out the corresponding relationship between the urban visual landscape element indexes and the landscape features; based on the corresponding relationship between the urban visual landscape indexes and the urban visual landscape features, constructing a structural equation model of the influence of the urban visual landscape features on public preference; and adjusting indexes of the structural equation model to obtain the urban visual landscape evaluation model.

title: Model training method and device, instant pushing method and device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to a model training method and device, an instant pushing method and device, a medium and electronic equipment, belongs to the technical field of computers, and can realize model training in an end intelligent scene. The invention discloses a federated learning-based model training method. The method comprises the following steps of: encrypting label values of a plurality of first participants which have labels and have the same characteristics and different samples and transmitting the label values to a second participants which have no labels and have samples of all the first participants but have characteristics different from those of the first participants; the second participant determines a second gradient based on the encrypted tag value and the feature value of the owned feature and transmits the second gradient to the first participant, and the first participant determines a first gradient and a first histogram based on the feature value of the owned feature and the tag value of the owned feature and transmits the first gradient and the first histogram to the second participant; the first participant determines a first optimal splitting point based on the second gradient and transmits the first optimal splitting point to the second participant; and the second participant determines a global optimal splitting point based on the first gradient, the first histogram and the first optimal splitting point and transmits the global optimal splitting point to the first participant.

title: Edge cluster management method, device and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an edge cluster management method, device and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of cloud, in particular to the technical fields of edge clusters, big data processing, Internet of Things and the like.
