The specific implementation scheme is as follows: obtaining a target application associated with a target node in a virtual cluster; the target node has a corresponding target edge device in the edge cluster; the target node is any virtual node in the virtual cluster; and sending the target application to the edge cluster so as to install the target application to the target edge device. According to the management mode provided by the embodiment of the invention, the establishment of the edge cluster can be flexibly realized, so that the edge cluster can use the computing power of the edge cluster to complete edge computing. And the method has universality, and deployment and management of the edge cluster can be efficiently completed.

title: Job scheduling method and device for deep learning-oriented distributed computing system
abstract: The invention discloses a job scheduling method and device for a deep learning-oriented distributed computing system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining job information inputted by a user, storing the job information in a database, maintaining a job priority queue according to the job information, acquiring cache information of each node in the cluster; responding to a received request for initiating job execution, executing the job execution according to the sequence of the priority queues, scheduling the job to a corresponding host node for execution, and storing an execution result in a database; in response to a received request of a model updating job, querying data required by the job in the database, calculating the remaining end time of the job, and storing a calculation result in the database; and responding to and receiving the queue updating request, querying required data in the database, and updating the queue according to the data. According to the method, user input information is less depended, and the job execution time prediction precision is effectively improved.

title: Edge calculation-oriented revocable public verifiable calculation method
abstract: The invention provides an edge-computing-oriented revocable public verifiable computing method, and relates to the technical field of power systems, the property of a group signature is utilized, and terminal equipment can verify a computing result returned by any edge server with a group signature authorization certificate only by reserving a group signature public key, so that the computing efficiency is improved. And after a new edge server is encountered, a key does not need to be transmitted, edge server information which a user does not need to know is hidden, and an administrator can open a group signature to lock the edge server which provides a wrong calculation result. In addition, the invention also designs a Subset Coverage Tree (SCT) for remarkably reducing the overhead of storing the revocation list by the terminal equipment and improving the efficiency of updating the revocation list. Complicated communication is not needed, large storage space is not needed, calculation and verification are efficient, and performance overhead is greatly reduced.

title: Cooperative reasoning acceleration method based on queuing theory
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of edge computing, and relates to a collaborative reasoning acceleration method based on a queuing theory. Comprising the steps of 1, establishing a task attribute model; 2, establishing a communication model; step 3, making a decision on whether to directly upload to the cloud server according to the current queue state information, if so, carrying out step 7, otherwise, carrying out step 4; 4, DNN model partitioning is carried out, if the task does not trigger the regret mechanism at the moment, the step 5 is executed, and otherwise, the step 6 is executed; 5, based on the step 4, the edge server cooperatively executes the reasoning task and goes to the step 8; step 6, triggering a regret mechanism, and turning to step 7 for the deep section part of the DNN model; 7, uploading the model to a cloud server, completing the aggregation of reasoning results, and entering a step 8; 8, obtaining a model partitioning strategy and total reasoning time delay at the moment; when the total reasoning time delay is no longer reduced, outputting an optimal model partitioning strategy and a minimum reasoning time delay; and model partition points are optimized in combination with queue state information, so that the system reasoning time delay is minimized.

title: Cloud desktop terminal computing power resource management method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a cloud desktop terminal computing power resource management method and system, and belongs to the technical field of cloud computing, Kubernetes cloud is adopted to realize resource management on an edge computing node side, and meanwhile, the Kubernetes cloud is responsible for unified multi-cluster scheduling management of a bottom embedded terminal cluster; the front-end embedded terminal cluster adopts a K3S cloud native platform to realize resource management; the method comprises the following steps: managing each piece of cloud desktop terminal equipment by expanding a device plug and expanding a k8s schemuler; and a computing power dispatcher on the whole edge side is realized on the basis of a self-defined Kubernetes label. Uniform identification of heterogeneous chips in a computing power network connection range can be realized, and various terminal computing power resources of different manufacturers are accessed into the computing power network to jointly create computing power circulation.

title: Incremental training-based call chain anomaly detection model training method and device
abstract: The invention provides a training method and device of a call chain anomaly detection model based on incremental training. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a preset first time period into a plurality of time segments; taking the earliest time segment as a first time segment; obtaining first historical call chain information, and obtaining a first call chain information set according to the first historical call chain information; training a call chain anomaly detection model by adopting the first call chain information set to obtain an initial call chain anomaly detection model; taking other time segments as second time segments; obtaining second historical call chain information, and obtaining a second call chain information set according to the second historical call chain information; performing incremental training on the initial call chain anomaly detection model by adopting the second call chain information set to obtain a call chain anomaly detection model; and storing the call chain anomaly detection model in a server. According to the invention, the time required for training the model can be shortened, and the model training efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Work order scheduling system based on 5G private network
abstract: The invention relates to a work order scheduling system based on a 5G private network, the work order scheduling system comprises a work order creation library module, a worker management module and a work order scheduling module, a work order template database is constructed, the work order template database is updated in real time through the 5G private network, and work order information is obtained; and generating first work order features according to the work order information, creating a work order according to the first work order features and the work order template database, obtaining worker feature data and worker state data, and scheduling the work order according to the plurality of first work order features, the worker state data and the worker feature data. Through the work order scheduling method and device, the technical problem that work order scheduling is difficult to effectively distribute in related technologies is solved, and the effect of efficiently and reasonably completing work order scheduling is achieved.

title: Data vectorization retrieval method and device based on inference in database
abstract: The invention discloses a data vectorization retrieval method and device based on inference in a database. The traditional picture and text vectorization retrieval is often realized in a plurality of systems, but the method can be directly realized in a database system, so that the difficulty of a system designer is greatly reduced, and the development difficulty of an upper application is greatly reduced. On the basis of a deep learning inference system in the database, the vectorization retrieval method of the pictures and the texts is realized, a storage engine at the bottom layer of the database is changed into vectorization storage, and lighter storage and more efficient retrieval of the picture and text data are realized. According to the image and text data retrieval method, the vectorization processing process is accelerated through hierarchical navigation graphs and vector product quantization, rough but fast screening is carried out in a large data range, then fine calculation screening is carried out in a small data range, and the performance of the image and text data retrieval method is greatly improved.

title: Model training method, method and device for controlling heating and ventilation system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a model training method, a method and device for controlling a heating and ventilation system, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the fields of cloud computing, Internet of Things, industrial digital intelligence, industrial Internet, edge computing and the like. According to the specific implementation scheme, a plurality of training samples are determined, wherein the training samples comprise running state data and action data; wherein the operation state data represents operation states of N devices in the heating and ventilation system, and the action data represents a control strategy for the operation state of at least one target device in the N devices; n is an integer greater than or equal to 1; determining a target evaluation value corresponding to the action data, wherein the target evaluation value represents energy consumption required for operating the heating and ventilation system based on the action data; determining an estimated evaluation value for the heating and ventilation system based on a heating and ventilation system control model according to the running state data and the action data; and training the heating and ventilation system control model according to the estimated evaluation value and the target evaluation value.

title: Video retrieval method based on attention and knowledge distillation
abstract: The invention discloses a video retrieval method based on attention and knowledge distillation, and belongs to the technical field of video retrieval matching. Extracting feature maps of different granularity levels by using a region maximum convolution activation strategy, generating frame-level features of a complete video, and calculating final video frame features according to the attention weight of each frame after eliminating simple interference frames; for each video pair sample, the teacher network obtains a final video frame feature in the index stage, calculates the similarity between video pairs based on the final video frame feature in the retrieval stage, and adopts triple loss to train the teacher network; respectively guiding and training a fine-grained student network and a coarse-grained student network by using a teacher network; and evaluating the video similarity calculated by the coarse-grained student network, determining whether to call the fine-grained student network, and finally obtaining a similarity result between the videos to realize retrieval. Based on the video retrieval method provided by the invention, relatively high accuracy and relatively high retrieval efficiency can be obtained.

title: Efficient strong privacy protection federated learning system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an efficient strong privacy protection federated learning system and method, relates to the technical field of federated learning, and solves the problem that efficient cooperative training cannot be carried out on the premise of ensuring strong privacy and correctness of a model in the prior art. The system comprises training participants, and a parameter server is used for initializing a training model and a homomorphic pseudorandom sequence generator and generating a re-encryption key; the aggregation server is used for performing aggregation operation on gradient updates of the ciphertexts uploaded by the participants; aggregation operation is carried out on the pseudo-random sequence seeds of the multiple participants in the ciphertext state, and after a round of interaction with all online participants is carried out, re-encrypted aggregation seeds are fed back to all the online participants; performing aggregation calculation on the plurality of verification parameters, and returning a calculation result to the participant; according to the method, the mask vector encryption model generated by the SHPRG is used, so that the encryption efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Data processing method and system of virtual power plant edge computing gateway
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method and system for a virtual power plant edge computing gateway, relates to the field of industrial internet, and can effectively utilize mass multi-modal sample data and position sample data to train a model to obtain a task scheduling instruction model, and the task scheduling instruction model is used for scheduling the virtual power plant edge computing gateway. The trained task scheduling instruction model is deployed at the edge gateway node, and the edge gateway node can quickly identify the task scheduling instruction according to model prediction and analysis, so that the identification efficiency and accuracy of different task scheduling instructions in a heterogeneous network are higher, the edge collaboration effect is improved, and the task scheduling efficiency is improved. The task scheduling instruction transmitted by the cloud computing platform/network node is decomposed into the task scheduling instruction for the terminal equipment in the subsequent process, and the task scheduling instruction is accurately issued to the terminal equipment for equipment adjustment.

title: Federal learning task cluster scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a cluster scheduling method and system for federal learning tasks. The system comprises an application subsystem, a scheduling service subsystem, a task cluster subsystem and a storage subsystem. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a federated learning task submitted by an application subsystem through a scheduling service subsystem, splitting the federated learning task into a plurality of sub-tasks which are executed in sequence, and issuing each sub-task to a corresponding target task node in a task cluster subsystem according to a task execution sequence; and executing the received subtask through the target task node based on a federated learning algorithm to obtain an execution result and an execution state, and writing the execution result into the storage subsystem when the execution state is detected to be execution completion. By decoupling the scheduling service subsystem and the task cluster subsystem based on the federated learning algorithm in the scheduling system, it is convenient to schedule cluster nodes to execute federated learning tasks.

title: Multi-algorithm scheduling method based on video input
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-algorithm scheduling method based on video input. The method comprises the following steps: 1) collecting video data of double cameras (DVP and MIPI); 2) segmenting and zooming the large-resolution image data; 3) two paths of video tasks are flexibly scheduled and processed; 4) task-based dual-core scheduling processing; and 5) sequentially outputting algorithm reasoning results according to the number of the input image. According to the method, video acquisition images can be continuously processed through one-time configuration, participation of a CPU is greatly reduced, and the neural network acceleration efficiency is improved.

title: Federal learning method and system for fragmented block chain
abstract: The invention provides a federated learning method and system for a fragmented block chain, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an initial training model through a leader sub-node of each fragmented sub-chain, publishing the initial training model to other sub-nodes of the corresponding fragmented sub-chain, and constructing a DAG main chain through the leader sub-node of each fragmented sub-chain; in each round of training, each leader sub-node selects a training basic model based on the weight of the vertex in the current DAG main chain, carries out training in the sub-chain to which the leader sub-node belongs based on the training basic model, and updates the DAG main chain; in the training process of the segmented sub-chain, each sub-node of the segmented sub-chain determines the optimal request data quantity based on the CPU frequency of the sub-node, the energy consumption coefficient corresponding to the chip and the CPU period number required for training one sample data, and the training model of the sub-node is trained based on the optimal request data quantity; and aggregating the training models of which all sub-nodes of the segmented sub-chain are trained to the corresponding leader sub-nodes.

title: Method and device for pre-reading file based on network shared directory
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for pre-reading a file based on a network sharing directory and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of network sharing, the method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a link prediction model which comprises two embedded layers and a prediction output layer which are matched in sequence; s2, performing parameter optimization on two embedded layers of the link prediction model through expected reading information and actual reading information in a current state; s3, respectively extracting an embedded representation vector with network structure information corresponding to each shared file through the optimized embedded layer; and S4, inputting the embedded representation vector into the prediction output layer, and performing prediction through the prediction output layer to obtain pre-read information in a current state. By extracting the embedded representation vector integrated with the file name and the position relation and carrying out online learning on the access behavior of the user, the file needing to be pre-read is predicted and obtained, so that the accuracy of cross-file pre-reading in network sharing is improved.

title: Electricity-carbon graph data fusion and multi-dimensional characterization method
abstract: The invention provides an electricity-carbon graph data fusion and multi-dimensional representation method, which comprises the following steps: deploying edge computing nodes, and establishing an edge computing node network; determining key fusion data in the electricity-carbon graph data, and distributing the key fusion data to each edge computing node in the edge computing node network; on the basis of the key fusion data in each edge computing node, utilizing a pre-established deep learning model to predict and obtain a power consumption demand and a carbon emission trend at a prediction moment; and carrying out visual display on the power consumption demand and the carbon emission trend at the prediction moment. According to the method, the edge calculation and deep learning technologies are combined, the efficiency and accuracy of electric carbon data processing are improved, the calculation burden of data fusion is reduced through the edge calculation, real-time monitoring is more feasible, the precision of multi-dimensional representation is improved through deep learning, it is ensured that the model can adapt to changes of a power system in a self-adaptive mode through the reinforcement learning technology, and the real-time monitoring accuracy is improved. And the solution is more flexible.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR SCHEDULING JOB FOR HIGH FREQUENCY TRADING
abstract: The present disclosure provides a task scheduling method for a high frequency transaction performed by at least one processor. The method comprises the steps of: obtaining a plurality of input data for a high frequency transaction; determining a workload for an inference operation of a machine learning model based on an allowable time until task completion and available hardware resources; selecting at least one input data from the plurality of input data based on the determined workload; and applying the selected at least one input data to the machine learning model.

title: ASYNCHRONOUS FEDERATED LEARNING METHOD FOR PROTECTING USER PRIVACY
abstract: An electronic device may include a memory, a communication module, and a processor. The processor may be configured to acquire an artificial intelligence model from a server through the communication module. The processor may be configured to sample a layer of the artificial intelligence model. The processor may be configured to perform model training by applying direct feedback alignment to the sampled layer of the artificial intelligence model. The processor may be configured to transmit a parameter of the sampled layer to which the local differential privacy is applied to the server through the communication module.

title: Communication method, communication apparatus, and system
abstract: This application provides a communication method, a communications apparatus, and a system. The method comprises: sending, by a network device, first indication information to a terminal device, where the first indication information indicates the terminal device to report first information used to determine a plurality of beams on which an uplink signal can be simultaneously transmitted; and receiving, by the network device, first information or second information from the terminal device, where the second information indicates that the terminal device does not have a beam used to simultaneously transmit an uplink signal. The network device triggers, by using the first indication information, the terminal device to report the plurality of beams that can be used for uplink simultaneous transmission, so that the network device learns of the beams that can be used for uplink simultaneous transmission to perform uplink simultaneous transmission scheduling.

title: SKETCHED AND CLUSTERED FEDERATED LEARNING WITH AUTOMATIC TUNING
abstract: A computer-implemented method, a computer program product, and a computer system for automatic adaptive client selection in federated learning. A server sends parameters of a machine learning model to all of clients, where all of the clients compute respective gradients using the parameters. The server receives sketches of the respective gradients, where the sketches are computed by all of the clients. The server uses the sketches to compute similarity between all of the clients and clusters the all of the clients based on the similarity. The server optimizes a number of client clusters and a dimension of the sketches, subject to a constraint of memory consumption, a constraint of communication overhead, and a performance metric. The server determines a subset of the clients that send the respective gradients, by selecting the clients from the client clusters. The server aggregates the respective gradients sent by the subset of the clients.

title: LOW-DISRUPTION MAINTENANCE OF CLUSTER INFRASTRUCTURE
abstract: Applications supporting operations of an autonomous vehicle fleet can be implemented on and supported by cluster infrastructure. Demands on the cluster infrastructure from these systems can vary greatly and change often. Specifications for the hardware and software for the cluster infrastructure may be updated frequently. Therefore, significant resources can be spent to maintain the cluster infrastructure. If not managed or monitored properly, some changes to the cluster infrastructure may cause disruption to the systems running on the cluster infrastructure. The process of managing the upgrades to the cluster infrastructure can be laborious. To address at least some of these concerns, a computer-implemented operator can determine a migration plan based on the systems that are running on the cluster infrastructure. A windowed and monitored migration can be carried out by the computer-implemented operator to minimize disruption and to reduce over usage of resources in the cluster infrastructure during the migration.

title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE/MACHINE LEARNING TRAINING SERVICES IN NON-REAL TIME RADIO ACCESS NETWORK INTELLIGENT CONTROLLER
abstract: A machine-readable storage medium, an apparatus and a method, each corresponding to either a service consumer or a service producer of a non-real-time (non-RT) radio access network intelligent controller (RIC) of a Service Management and Orchestration Framework (SMO FW). Communications from the service consumer to the service producer include: a training request for artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) training job; a query regarding a training status of the AI/ML training job; a cancel training request to cancel the AI/ML training job; and a notification regarding the training status of the AI/ML training job.

title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE PATIENT INTAKE AND APPOINTMENT BOOKING SYSTEM
abstract: A solution for patient scheduling systems, designed to streamline the appointment booking process and enhance the overall patient experience is provided. The solution may include a kiosk computer system that interacts with a patient using voice recognition technology. The solution may include an appointment booking system. The appointment booking system may include an interactive voice response system, a middleware system and an electronic health record system. The system may also include an artificial intelligence model that is less susceptible to hallucinations. provide a seamless and efficient appointment booking process. The solution may adapt to office-specific requirements and improve patient satisfaction and practice efficiency.

title: OPTIMIZING JOB PREEMPTION USING DYNAMIC AND STATIC INFORMATION
abstract: In an approach for optimizing job preemption using a scheduling mechanism that considers dynamic and static information, a processor, responsive to a pending job being selected to be run, determines that no computing hosts within a computing cluster have available resources capable of running the pending job and non-preemptive measures will not provide required resources for the pending job. A processor identifies candidate jobs for preemption and dynamic information and static information for each candidate job. A processor ranks the candidate jobs for preemption based on the dynamic information and the static information for each candidate job. A processor attempts to preempt a top N candidate jobs whose released resources in combination with the available resources of the computing cluster satisfy the required resources of the pending job. A processor, responsive to successfully preempting the top N candidate jobs, initiates the pending job.

title: Machine Learning Training with Enforced Differential Privacy Using Secure Multi-Party Computation
abstract: Methods and systems for training machine learning models with enforced differential privacy using Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) protocols are disclosed. A method for generating random bits for a Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) protocol in a machine learning model training system includes locally generating, at each participating node, a plurality of random bits using a cryptographically secure pseudorandom number generator (CSPRNG). The locally generated random bits provided as input to the SMPC protocol and combined using an exclusive or (XOR) or addition operation to produce a set of combined random bits. A statistical sampling process for Differential Privacy (DP) is performed using the combined random bits as inputs. The perturbed training data is then utilized in the SMPC protocol to train the machine learning model.

title: METHOD AND A SYSTEM FOR THE OPTIMIZED TRAINING OF A MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHM
abstract: A method for optimized training of a machine learning algorithm. The method includes: providing a domain model that has domain parameters and/or domain values for at least one domain;providing a data model that has a training data set including training data for the at least one domain;removing/hiding/modifying at least one training datum from the training data set depending on at least one domain parameter and/or domain value to provide a reduced training data set;training a neural network based on the reduced training data set to determine a model performance depending on the reduced data set; comparing the determined model performance with a model performance associated with the training data set; selecting training data from the training data set depending on the comparison of the model performances; training the machine learning algorithm based on the selected training data; and providing the trained machine learning algorithm.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE SUPPORTING MANUFACTURE OF SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE AND OPERATING METHOD OF ELECTRONIC DEVICE
abstract: Disclosed is an operating method of an electronic device which includes a processor and supports manufacture of a semiconductor device. The method includes receiving, at the processor, layout data for the manufacture of the semiconductor device, feature data of the layout data, and skew data after the semiconductor device is manufactured; inferring, at the processor, a center and a distribution of a skew of each of patterns and/or edges of the layout data based on the layout data and the feature data, by using a deep learning module; calculating, at the processor, a loss based on the center and the distribution of the skew based on the skew data, and training, at the processor, the deep learning module based on the loss, and the layout data, the feature data, and the skew data are formatted as tabular data.

title: SOFTWARE AS A SERVICE (SAAS) SYSTEM FOR THE DETERMINATION OF SPECIFIC CALCULATED INDIVIDUAL FUNCTIONAL CHANGES IN THE LEVEL OF RESOURCE NEEDS USING UNIQUE IDENTIFIERS WITHIN ACTIVITIES OF DAILY LIVING, COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT, SOCIAL, AND EDUCATIONAL ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: The software as a service (SAAS) platform of the present invention analyzes an individual's functional capabilities by comparing self-reported data with professional observations. It utilizes research-based normative data to calculate changes in function across various domains, such as activities of daily living and cognitive function. The system generates reports with graphical representations and detailed analyses of deficits or gains. It also projects long-term status changes and calculates resource requirements, using databases of costs and aids to provide cost analyses. This platform aids in various areas, including disability claims, insurance claims, legal disputes, and rehabilitation planning, by tracking functional changes to optimize resource use and improve outcomes.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MULTI-GENERATIONAL SAVINGS INSTRUMENT
abstract: A non-transitory computer readable medium storing computer-executable instructions that, when executed by a processor, cause a machine learning (ML) engine and/or Artificial Intelligence (AI) to: train a machine learning model of the machine learning engine using financial datasets; providing parameter values to a Savings Plan Creator via a user interface; generating, by the Savings Plan Creator, a savings plan for a short or a long-term savings instrument based on the provided parameter values, the savings plan creator being driven by the machine learning engine that matches the provided parameter values to an existing savings plan selected from a Plans Database having existing savings plans stored therein, or that synthesizes a customized savings plan.

title: COMPUTING-POWER SCHEDULING METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract: Provided in the present application is a computing-power scheduling method, comprising: a first device acquiring a computing-power resource request, wherein the computing-power resource request comes from an access stratum (AS), a non-access stratum (NAS) or an application layer of the first device; and the first device generating computing-power request information according to the computing-power resource request, wherein the computing-power request information is used for requesting that computing power resources are allocated to the first device. Wireless signaling is sent to a network side by means of a UE, so that the network side schedules computing power resources according to the signaling and allocates the computing power resources to the UE, thereby implementing computing power sharing and scheduling in a wireless network.

title: OPTICAL NAVIGATION SYSTEM FOR SPACECRAFT
abstract: Systems and methods related to an optical navigation system for spacecraft are disclosed herein. The optical navigation system combines several types of sensors together into a compact optical sensor system, maintaining the functionality of each type of sensor. The optical navigation system uses optical sensors, artificial intelligence, auto dimming, and other features to perform navigation functions such as sun sensing, horizon sensing, and star tracking. Artificial intelligence may include deep neural networks that are trained to provide complex machine vision applications. The optical navigation system may be organized into modular slices to increase customizability. Types of slices may include optical slices, network switch slices, vision navigation slices, and inertial navigation system switch slices. Software packages for the navigation system are also customizable, reducing user cost and complexity to be only what is required for a given application.

title: A SYSTEM AND A COMPUTER IMPLEMENTED METHOD FOR AN AGRONOMICAL ENVIRONMENT
abstract: The disclosure relates to providing agronomical data for re-training a pre-trained transformer-based model for an agronomical task. The disclosure further relates to using the trained transformer-based model for controlling and/or monitoring an agronomical environment.

title: PROCESSING UNIT FOR TRAINING A DEEP NEURAL NETWORK (DNN) AND METHOD FOR DETERMINING A CHARACTERISTIC VALUE OF A DATA SET OF TRAINING DATA
abstract: A processing unit (10) for training a deep neural network (DNN) using data sets of training data in the high-bit floating-point format, comprising a memory unit (30); a processor chip (20) having a processor unit (22) and having a memory controller unit (30) that comprises a PHY controller (32) for communication with the memory unit (30) and an interface (36) for communication with the processor unit (22). The memory controller unit (30) has a quantization unit (40) for changing the floating-point format of the training data of the data sets, and an estimation unit (42) for estimating a characteristic value of the training data of the data sets. The memory controller unit (30) is designed and configured to reduce the floating-point format of the training data on the basis of the characteristic value of the training data and to perform a data transmission of the reduced-format training data to and from the memory unit (30).

title: OPTIMIZATION METHOD FOR AI ACCELERATOR, AND AI ACCELERATOR
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of AI accelerators. Disclosed are an optimization method for an AI accelerator, and an AI accelerator, which solve the technical problem of the time consumed by evolutionary algorithms in existing AI accelerators being relatively long. The optimization method comprises: preparing raw data, removing abnormal data, then performing labeling to obtain labeled data, and selecting a portion of the labeled data as a training set; determining a search space for genetic programming, defining a function set and a terminal set, and performing preprocessing, feature extraction, feature concatenation, regression and result output on the labeled data; defining a fitness function for the genetic programming; and on the basis of the function set, the terminal set and the fitness function, performing population initialization, fitness evaluation, genetic-operation execution and genetic-termination condition determination on the training set, and performing searching to obtain a target neural network architecture. The present invention uses genetic programming to optimize the performance of an AI accelerator, and a neural network architecture with the optimal weight precision and the optimal feature precision is obtained by means of searching, thereby reducing computational costs.

title: Federal learning backdoor attack method and device, storage medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses a federated learning backdoor attack method and device, a storage medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence security. The method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out fast Fourier transform on a clean image and a trigger image to obtain amplitude spectrums and phase spectrums of the clean image and the trigger image; obtaining a synthetic amplitude spectrum according to the amplitude spectrums of the clean image and the trigger image; obtaining a poisoning image corresponding to the clean image according to the synthesized amplitude spectrum and the phase spectrum of the clean image; clean images and categories of the clean images are determined as a clean data set; determining the clean data set, all poisoning images and the target category of each poisoning image as a poisoning data set; taking the poisoning data set as a training set, and performing backdoor attack on federal learning to obtain a final global model; the final global model is used for testing the test data provided with the trigger image. According to the method, the security and robustness of the global model can be improved through a more hidden federated learning backdoor attack test.

title: Federal learning backdoor attack-oriented defense method
abstract: The invention discloses a federated learning backdoor attack-oriented defense method. The federated learning backdoor attack-oriented defense method comprises the following four steps for filtering, judging, detecting and removing potential federated backdoors: firstly, preliminarily filtering potential backdoor models by using a self-adaptive aggregation algorithm; detecting whether the federated learning model has a backdoor or not by reversing the potential trigger and performing abnormal value detection, and performing simple processing on the basis to judge which type of tag is implanted into the backdoor; and finally, removing the back door of the corresponding category through a back door forgetting technology so as to achieve a model repairing effect. Through the above steps, various potential federated learning backdoor attacks can be effectively defended, the security of the federated learning model is improved, and the federated learning model is ensured to quickly fall into the ground.

title: Session management system based on cloud edge cooperation technology
abstract: The invention discloses a session management system based on a cloud-side cooperation technology, which belongs to the technical field of computer networks and comprises a cloud server and a plurality of edge servers, the cloud server is used for global session management and session information data transceiving and caching of the edge servers, and the edge servers are connected with the cloud server and the edge servers. The edge server is connected with the cloud server; the edge server comprises a session receiving unit, a session sending unit, a feedback unit and a cache unit, the session receiving unit is used for receiving session information sent by the client equipment, the cache unit is used for temporarily storing the session information, and the session sending unit is used for sending the session information to the cloud server. According to the invention, the user session data is processed and analyzed in real time by using the edge computing technology, the data transmission delay is reduced, the response speed and performance of the system are improved, and the security and privacy of the user session data are ensured by adopting various security measures, such as encrypted transmission and access control.

title: Digital twinning-based car networking task unloading method
abstract: The invention relates to an Internet of Vehicles task unloading method based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of Internet of Vehicles. The method comprises the steps that S1, a vehicle edge calculation model based on digital twinning is established, the vehicle edge calculation model comprises a vehicle, an edge server RSU and digital twinning bodies corresponding to the vehicle and the edge server RSU, and the digital twinning bodies of the vehicle at least comprise task attributes with task priority parameters; s2, a task unloading calculation model is constructed based on the vehicle edge calculation model, task unloading calculation mainly comprises local calculation, unloading to RUS calculation and unloading to collaborative vehicle calculation, and the calculation time delay of an unloading decision at least considers whether cache content of the same decision exists or not; and S3, modeling a task unloading decision problem into a Markov decision process, and solving based on an unloading algorithm of double depth Q. An unloading algorithm based on double depth Q and an allocation scheme based on task priority are provided in a calculation unloading part, so that task processing time delay is minimized.

title: Video analysis task unloading and video transmission configuration selection method and device in edge environment
abstract: The invention discloses a video analysis task unloading and video transmission configuration selection method and device in an edge environment. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model for a video analysis task unloading scene; establishing system models including a video analysis accuracy model and an energy consumption model; establishing an optimization objective function for the video analysis task unloading problem according to the system model; establishing a problem function according to the optimization objective function; and solving the problem function by adopting a multi-arm bandit algorithm, selecting an optimal edge server to perform task unloading, and determining the optimal configuration for unloading the video to the server. According to the method, the video analysis accuracy and the video transmission energy consumption are comprehensively considered, the optimal edge server is selected for video task unloading under the condition that the available edge server cluster is uncertain, the video analysis accuracy can be effectively improved, network resources are saved, and the comprehensive effectiveness is improved.

title: Personalized federal learning algorithm realized by separating different clients
abstract: The invention relates to a personalized federated learning algorithm realized by separating different clients, and belongs to the field of personalized federated learning, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, before the algorithm starts, a client cluster participating in the algorithm completes pre-training, and uploads a neural network model to a server; s2, using an iterative removal screening algorithm to obtain an S clustering model, and dividing a client cluster into an SCD class and an MCD class; and S3, the server divides the SCD client into S clusters, and the clients in the clusters carry out iterative updating on the local model, the cloud model and the clustering model through local training. And S4, the server constructs a personalized optimization function for the MCD client, so that the MCD client iteratively updates the local model and the cloud model through local training.

title: Distributed power supply scheduling method and device based on reinforcement learning, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply dispatching, in particular to a distributed power supply dispatching method and device based on reinforcement learning, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: taking state information of all nodes as a global state; subtracting the global state of the previous adjacent moment from the global state of the current moment to obtain a global state variable quantity of the current moment, inputting an upper-layer reinforcement learning model to output an upper-layer decision result, and further positioning a to-be-adjusted power supply node; for the to-be-adjusted power supply node, taking the state information of all nodes connected to the to-be-adjusted power supply node as a local state; and calculating a local state variable quantity at the current moment, inputting the local state variable quantity into the lower-layer reinforcement learning model to output a lower-layer decision result, and adjusting the output power of the to-be-adjusted power supply node based on the lower-layer decision result. According to the technical scheme, the stability of the power distribution network can be ensured while supply-demand balance is realized, and accurate scheduling of the distributed power supply is realized.

title: Federal learning gradient attack defense method based on joint differential privacy
abstract: The invention discloses a federal learning gradient attack defense method based on joint differential privacy, and the method mainly comprises the following steps: 1, initializing system model parameters, and carrying out the mini-batch and micro-batch division of a training sample; 2, participants participating in federated learning training are randomly selected, and a micro-batch gradient is calculated; 3, according to the calculated micro-batch gradient, threshold value limiting cutting is carried out; step 4, micro-batch is used as a noise adding unit, gradient parameters of the participants with strong privacy guarantee are frozen, and Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradient vector; step 5, gradient parameter loss is calculated, mini-batch is taken as an updating unit of differential privacy model training, and global model training is carried out in a scene where gradient attacks exist; and step 6, updating system model parameters, and calculating model accuracy and a loss privacy protection effect. According to the method, in a federal learning scene with gradient attacks, the attack of the multi-classification task can be well resisted, and the accuracy of the model classification task can be ensured while the privacy guarantee is enhanced.

title: Privacy reasoning-oriented neural network depth pruning method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a privacy reasoning-oriented neural network depth pruning method and system, which are characterized in that a training sample is utilized to train a neural network to be pruned, and the average output state of each neuron Relu unit is counted in the training process; the Relu importance of each neuron is determined according to the average output state of the Relu units, structured pruning is carried out on the neuron Relu units of the neural network according to the Relu importance of the neuron, and the structured pruning comprises deleting the first-stage Relu unit with the lowest Relu importance of the neuron and carrying out interval deleting on each layer of Relu units in the neural network; based on the output state of each neuron unit and by using a preset threshold value, classifying the neurons after the structured pruning, obtaining an activation state Relu unit and an inhibition state Relu unit in the neurons of the neural network, and performing deep pruning on the activation state Relu unit and the inhibition state Relu unit respectively by using a specified pruning strategy; the neural network is adjusted according to the deep pruning result, an adjusted target neural network model is obtained, and the target neural network model is used for processing the input image. According to the method, the neural network pruning depth is increased and the accuracy of the pruned neural network is ensured based on the incidence relation between the neuron output rule and the ReLU importance distribution, the pruned neural network does not need to be retrained and redesigned, and deployment and implementation in application scenes such as automatic driving, face recognition and image detection are facilitated.

title: Data downloading method and device, equipment, storage medium and computer program product
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention provide a data downloading method, apparatus and device, a storage medium and a computer program product, applied to an AI platform, the method comprising: creating a data downloading task on a task control interface, the data downloading task comprising a downloading mode; starting a target downloading service according to the downloading mode; creating configuration information according to the target downloading service, and starting a target container based on the configuration information; and obtaining state information corresponding to the downloading task. According to the embodiment of the invention, the created data downloading task is scheduled and the POD container is started for downloading based on the AI cluster in the AI platform, and the data downloading task is created by designing the data downloading function based on the AI platform, so that multiple downloading modes can be supported, corresponding processing is carried out according to different downloading modes, and the data downloading efficiency is improved. A user can perform a visual operation data downloading function on the task control interface of the AI platform, does not need to care about a bottom layer implementation mechanism, and does not need to worry about downloading interruption and occupation of energy of developers due to long-time downloading.

title: Federal learning method and system based on block chain parallel voting consensus and multiple additional side chains
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, and discloses a federated learning method and system based on block chain parallel voting consensus and multiple additional side chains, and the method comprises the steps: accessing a federated learning system and issuing a training task according to the task demand of a demand side, initializing the training parameters of the training task according to the demand information of the training task, constructing a local model according to the training parameters, carrying out model training and parameter updating and verification on the local model, carrying out consensus uplink on the updated model passing verification and the updated parameters, carrying out aggregation and verification on the updated parameters, and carrying out consensus uplink on the aggregated parameters passing verification; and finally, setting consensus node roles according to consensus nodes of the main chain network of the block chain, performing parallel voting consensus on all the consensus node roles, and chaining a final voting result. Therefore, by implementing the method, the calculation and communication traffic of an enterprise server can be effectively reduced, the node pressure is relieved, the efficiency of global model data uplink evidence storage is improved, and the throughput and the processing capacity of the system are improved.

title: Method for scheduling artificial intelligence platform resources
abstract: The invention discloses a method for scheduling artificial intelligence platform resources, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps that an artificial intelligence AI platform receives an AI task request, and the types of tasks corresponding to the AI task request comprise a model training task, a model reasoning task and an interactive task; determining the priority of the task corresponding to the AI task request according to the resource attribute of the task corresponding to the AI task request; preferentially scheduling idle resources of the AI platform to the task with the highest priority in the tasks according to the priority of the tasks corresponding to the AI task request; the interrupted tasks with the lowest priority and the interrupted tasks with the medium priority are restarted after the tasks with the highest priority are completed and resources are released; the task with the lowest priority is restarted through the reserved weight at the breakpoint, and the task with the medium priority is directly restarted without reserving information at the breakpoint; reasonable and efficient scheduling of AI platform resources can be realized.

title: Multi-agent privacy protection control system for resisting DOS attack
abstract: The invention provides a multi-agent privacy protection control system for resisting DOS attack, which comprises N1 agent units, and each agent unit comprises a data acquisition module, a communication interface module, a security policy decision unit, a privacy protection unit and a task priority scheduling module. According to the method, the defense capability of the system to DOS attacks can be improved, the user privacy is protected, the accuracy of data processing and the response speed of the system are improved, the reliability and stability of the system are enhanced, and the method can adapt to different network environments and security requirements.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent scheduling method and system of combined ship
abstract: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent scheduling method and system of a combined ship, and belongs to the technical field of scheduling optimization. The method comprises the following steps: a scheduling center calculates a risk assessment value of a grid block range where the center position of each unmanned aerial vehicle is located, and judges whether the risk assessment value is greater than or equal to a preset risk threshold; if yes, obtaining a weather risk assessment value, an electric quantity risk assessment value and a safety risk assessment value of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and the dispatching center judges whether the weather risk assessment value and the electric quantity risk assessment value are respectively greater than or equal to respective corresponding threshold values, and if so, dispatches the unmanned aerial vehicle according to a preset safety priority rule, a task rate priority rule or an energy consumption priority rule. According to the method, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be accurately scheduled, high efficiency and high safety of task execution of the unmanned aerial vehicle are ensured, the response capability and risk management efficiency of ocean task execution of the unmanned aerial vehicle are improved, the charging frequency and maintenance and operation cost of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reduced, and the sustainability of the system is improved.

title: Group personalized federal learning
abstract: A system and method for group personalized federated learning and facilitating group personalized federated learning are provided. The system may provide the communication device with a global machine learning model generated based on federated learning. The system may also receive model parameters from the communication device generated by the communication device implementing a global machine learning model that determine local training data based in part on the communication device. The system may also determine a group of communication devices based on model parameters from the communication devices, and may assign one or more of a plurality of group-specific machine learning models to the group. A plurality of group-specific machine learning models may be associated with a global machine learning model. The system may also provide a respective group-specific machine learning model of the plurality of group-specific machine learning models to a subset of the communication devices in the group of communication devices.

title: Freight logistics management system based on big data and artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention discloses a freight logistics management system based on big data and artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of freight logistics management and comprises a data integration module, a big data analysis module and an artificial intelligence optimization module. The data integration module is used for collecting data from a plurality of data sources and cleaning and converting the collected data; the big data analysis module is used for analyzing the cleaned and converted data, extracting data features and performing prediction according to the data features; and the artificial intelligence optimization module is used for carrying out inventory management according to the prediction result and carrying out dynamic scheduling of the logistics vehicles according to the prediction result. Historical data are deeply mined and analyzed through the big data analysis module by using an advanced data analysis technology, logistics demands and trends can be accurately predicted, the artificial intelligence optimization module can perform intelligent scheduling and dynamic adjustment based on real-time data and analysis results, reasonable configuration and efficient utilization of logistics resources are ensured, and the logistics demand and trend can be accurately predicted. The no-load phenomenon is reduced.

title: Executor scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an executor scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a relation heterogeneous graph according to first nodes which represent a plurality of threat flows, second nodes which represent a plurality of executors, and a connection edge relation set; determining respective first feature vectors of a plurality of first nodes and respective second feature vectors of a plurality of second nodes in the relational heterogeneous graph by adopting a graph attention network; constructing a relationship homograph according to the inter-node similarity of the plurality of first nodes; determining respective third feature vectors of a plurality of first nodes in the relation identical composition by adopting a graph attention network; for each first node and each second node, according to the first feature vector and the third feature vector of the first node and the second feature vector of the second node, determining the attack probability of the threat traffic of the first node to an executor of the second node; and determining a scheduling measure of the executor of the second node according to the attack probability. And resource loss caused by frequent scheduling is effectively reduced.

title: Task processing method and device and cloud computer terminal
abstract: The invention provides a task processing method and device and a cloud computer terminal, and the method comprises the steps: determining a plurality of available edge servers around a target position according to the connectivity between the cloud computer terminal and the edge servers under the condition that a first task needs to be processed in the cloud computer terminal; the target position is the position of the cloud computer terminal; allocating the first task to at least two available edge servers according to the transmission delay between the cloud computer terminal and the available edge servers and the connectivity between the cloud computer terminal and the available edge servers; receiving task processing results returned after the at least two available edge servers process the tasks; according to the embodiment of the invention, while the tasks are efficiently allocated to a plurality of available edge servers around, the overall time delay can be effectively reduced, and the influence caused by path loss and shadow effect can be reduced, so that the success rate of collecting task processing results is effectively improved.

title: Federal learning multi-granularity grouping fine tuning method with high communication efficiency
abstract: The invention discloses a communication-efficient federated learning multi-granularity grouping fine tuning method, relates to the technical field of information security, and solves the technical problems that the communication overhead of the current federated learning is large and the model performance is weak in a non-independent identically distributed data (Non-IID) scene. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a pre-training model of a client through a LoRA low-rank parameter matrix; the client performs asymmetric fine adjustment on the parameter matrix B and uploads the matrix B to the server; the server performs multi-granularity grouping and calculates an intra-group weighted average low-rank matrix; and the server performs weighted averaging on the expert gating parameters corresponding to the clients to obtain an average expert gating parameter, and the average expert gating parameter is used for reasoning of a global model. According to the invention, the training and communication overhead of the LoRA is reduced by using the asymmetric training model of the low-rank adaptation matrix, and the precision of the model in a Non-IID scene is improved through a training mode of combining the LoRA with the mixed experts.

title: AIOT-based fire-fighting facility health situation detection and analysis system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to an AIOT-based fire-fighting facility health situation detection and analysis system. Comprising an acquisition layer, a transmission layer, a data layer, a support layer and an application layer. The acquisition layer uses a detection integration device to detect fire-fighting equipment and sends detection data to the transmission layer, the transmission layer transmits the data to the data layer, the data layer transmits the data to the supporting layer, the supporting layer transmits the data to the application layer, and finally the application layer generates an evaluation report. The acquisition layer consists of a smoke/temperature monitoring sensor, a wind pressure monitoring sensor, an illumination/noise monitoring sensor, a distance/slope measurement sensor or detector and an edge computing gateway, and a detection integrated device with a replaceable acquisition head is used for acquiring the data; the system working platform is divided into six layers; the potential safety hazard rate of a single fire-fighting facility and the potential safety hazard rate of the fire-fighting facilities of a social unit (having n fire-fighting facilities) can be calculated through related formulas according to detection data, and then evaluation is carried out.

title: Smart city evaluation method and system based on AI analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of AI analysis, and discloses a smart city evaluation method and system based on AI analysis, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the intelligent analysis of city information, and generating the feature data of the current situation of a city; a group perception feedback mechanism is used as fitness, and optimized city feature data is generated through a long-acting adaptability optimization process; and comparing the optimized city feature data with the city current situation feature data, and analyzing the difference before and after optimization, thereby obtaining an evaluation result of the smart city. The city health condition is quantified by comparing the city current situation with the predicted ideal optimization state, and the improvement direction is defined and the resource allocation is optimized by identifying the key gap; and meanwhile, dynamic evaluation and trend prediction are supported. The city improvement potential is visually displayed, the trust and satisfaction of residents on city management are improved, and more efficient smart city management is realized.

title: Multi-energy virtual power plant optimization scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-energy virtual power plant optimization scheduling method and system, belongs to the technical field of power optimization scheduling, and solves the problems that an existing single prediction model cannot meet the requirements of multi-energy virtual power plant optimization scheduling, a data set applied to prediction calculation is large, and the calculation cost is high. According to the method, the influence factor indexes of the output of the wind and photovoltaic units are screened by adopting the random forest algorithm, the output of the wind and photovoltaic units is predicted by using the artificial neural network algorithm, and the defects of a single algorithm are further made up through the hybrid prediction algorithm, so that the prediction accuracy is improved; a Monte Carlo method is adopted for simulation analysis for load prediction of the electric vehicle, a function with the minimum operation cost of the virtual power plant as an objective is established, an optimal scheduling model of the multi-energy virtual power plant is established, and the problem that prediction and optimization can only be performed for single distributed energy in the prior art is solved.

title: Target tracking method under appearance change of improved transformation model prediction network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of visual target tracking, in particular to a target tracking method under appearance change of an improved conversion model prediction network, which comprises the following steps: extracting target depth features by using a backbone network, and adapting to a target appearance state in combination with an online weight updating method; target tracking result information is collected based on the target appearance state, continuous result information is learned by using a cascaded LSTM network, and the current target appearance state is output; a model online learning sample utilization mechanism is improved, a reliable target sample is utilized to optimize the model weight, and the model is made to adapt to a new appearance target; predicting a new position of a new appearance target by using continuous frame target center point trajectory information, and weighting a target response score to enable a model to adapt to a new state of the target; according to the method, the current position of the target is predicted by using the continuous target center point position information, and the target response score is weighted when the appearance of the target changes, so that the interference of similar objects is relieved, and the tracking accuracy in the target appearance change process is enhanced.

title: Asynchronous training method and device of online learning AI chip
abstract: The invention provides an asynchronous training method and device of an online learning AI chip. The method comprises the following steps: when the AI chip is in a training mode, initializing a network synapse weight of a network model in the AI chip; deploying an asynchronous learning engine according to a built-in algorithm, wherein the asynchronous learning engine is used for scheduling a calculation mode of the calculation module; inputting training sample data into a network model in the AI chip to enable the calculation module to update a network synaptic weight; and determining whether the target synaptic weight completes training or not according to the updating times of the target synaptic weight in the network model and a preset times threshold. Therefore, the asynchronous learning engine is arranged in the embodiment to adjust the calculation mode of the calculation module, and the training times for updating all synaptic weights can be reduced.

title: Readmission prediction method and device, terminal equipment and medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of diabetes research, and provides a re-admission prediction method and device, terminal equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining clinical data of historical diabetic patients; according to the clinical data, the prior condition probability of re-admission of the diabetic patient is calculated; obtaining an embedded vector corresponding to the clinical data based on the graph neural network model, and encoding the clinical data into a binary vector; fusing the embedded vector and the binary vector to obtain a fused feature vector related to re-admission of the diabetic patient; a re-admission prediction model is constructed based on a Transform model; training a re-admission prediction model based on the fusion features and the clinical data to obtain a trained re-admission prediction model; and obtaining a re-admission prediction probability corresponding to the to-be-tested clinical data by using the re-admission prediction model. According to the invention, the accuracy of readmission prediction of diabetic patients can be improved, and accurate guidance is provided for medical resource allocation.

title: Calculation unloading and resource allocation method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative edge calculation
abstract: The invention provides a calculation unloading and resource allocation method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative edge calculation, and relates to the technical field of mobile edge calculation. Comprising a plurality of terminal devices, a mobile unmanned aerial vehicle flying around the terminal devices, and a hovering unmanned aerial vehicle hovering in the air and connected with a ground control base, the terminal devices carry out local calculation, the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle carries out partial calculation, and the hovering unmanned aerial vehicle carries out residual calculation; constructing an optimization model of the unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative edge computing system, and formulating optimization targets and constraint conditions of unloading and resource allocation; solving the optimization model by taking the minimization of the total energy consumption as a target, and jointly optimizing task allocation of the terminal equipment and the unmanned aerial vehicle, computing resource allocation and a flight path of the mobile unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the invention, computing resources of all terminal devices and two unmanned aerial vehicles are fully utilized, and the real-time performance and reliability of task processing are improved.

title: CCER forestry carbon sink project development system based on artificial intelligence technology monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a CCER forestry carbon sink project development system based on artificial intelligence technology monitoring, and relates to the technical field of carbon sink monitoring and optimization. According to the CCER forestry carbon sink project development system based on artificial intelligence technology monitoring, space-time estimation is carried out on CCER forestry carbon sink project data through the deep learning model, and the dynamic change of the carbon sink amount is accurately predicted. Spatial features are extracted through a convolutional neural network, time sequence data are analyzed in combination with a long-short-term memory network, and a carbon sink prediction model is constructed. And through statistical analysis and a spatial interpolation algorithm, carbon sink quantity change is monitored in real time, an abnormal trend is identified, and early warning is provided. Based on a mixed integer linear programming algorithm, forest land resource allocation and vegetation types are optimized, a carbon sink optimization scheme is generated, and carbon sink benefit maximization is promoted. And through an intelligent carbon sink management scheme, sustainable ecological development and green and economic popularization are assisted.

title: Decision-making large model-oriented multi-level heterogeneous memory collaborative scheduling method
abstract: The invention provides a decision-making large model-oriented multi-level heterogeneous memory collaborative scheduling method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring hardware configuration information and initial state information of a heterogeneous memory system, constructing a burst memory access model based on an Erlang distribution family, and acquiring dynamic memory access characteristics in combination with self-adaptive stratified sampling; representing the state of the memory system by adopting multi-dimensional efficiency measurement and a hierarchical affinity matrix; predicting load characteristics based on a generalized extreme value theory, and constructing an augmented Lagrange optimization model to generate a resource allocation scheme; formulating a data migration strategy through a Pareto optimization algorithm; and dynamic parameter adjustment of Thompson sampling and an exception handling mechanism based on a combined early warning index are introduced. According to the method, memory access features can be accurately described, resource allocation is optimized, migration overhead is reduced, and large decision model training efficiency is improved.

title: Power market subject risk dynamic quantitative evaluation method based on joint machine learning
abstract: The invention discloses an electric power market subject risk dynamic quantitative evaluation method based on joint machine learning, belongs to the technical field of electric power market subject risk dynamic evaluation, and adopts a semi-supervised support vector machine-order relation-entropy weight SSVM-OR-EW joint machine learning algorithm to quantify market individual comprehensive risks. An SOD risk coefficient method in a DFMEA risk management theory is introduced to assess the dynamic optimal risk coefficient of a market subject, and the market risk is dynamically and flexibly quantified. Through market risk quantification, the risk management capability can be improved, the decision support can be enhanced, the capital configuration can be optimized, and an effective early warning mechanism can be established, so that the potential loss can be reduced. Meanwhile, market transparency can be promoted, investment portfolio can be optimized, confidence of investors can be improved, compliance and auditing requirements can be guaranteed to be met, and finally more efficient resource allocation and more stable operation can be achieved.

title: Cloud-edge fused secure storage system
abstract: The invention discloses a secure storage system for cloud edge fusion, and belongs to the field of data storage security. Comprising a plurality of edge ends and a central cloud storage end; the edge end carries out efficient filtering processing on large-scale data, then homomorphic encryption security processing and encryption based on edge end integration are carried out, and then storage is carried out; key data in the stored data is safely stored through active encryption after deduplication at the central cloud storage end by the edge ends, and the central cloud storage end provides the same performance guarantee for different edge ends through performance isolation of file system behavior perception; the edge end and the central cloud storage end cooperate with each other to execute cloud-side security de-duplication, cloud-side security synchronization and cloud-side data hierarchical storage tasks, and execution of the cloud-side tasks is scheduled by an intelligent agent maintained by the central cloud storage end according to requirements of different cloud-side tasks and the state of the edge end. Performance and safety of the cloud side storage system can be considered, storage performance is optimized, system delay is reduced, and data safety and reliability are ensured.

title: Prompt injection classifier using intermediate results
abstract: An analysis engine receives data characterizing a prompt for ingestion by a generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) model. An intermediate result of the GenAI model or a proxy of the GenAI model responsive to the prompt is obtained. The analysis engine, using a prompt injection classifier and the intermediate result, determines whether the prompt comprises or is indicative of malicious content or elicits malicious actions. Data characterizing the determination is provided to a consuming application or process. Related apparatus, systems, techniques and articles are also described.

title: AUGMENTED LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR COMMUNICATION WORKFLOWS
abstract: A method for performing computer-based tasks using computer applications and a machine learning model (MLM) includes identifying, within input data, a set of requests for performing corresponding computer-based tasks, utilizing the MLM. This identification process includes determining a computer application for executing the request and determining a programming instruction. The programming instruction includes a call to the computer application using an application programming interface (API) associated with the computer application. For the set of requests, the method includes generating computer instructions outlining a sequence for executing a set of programming instructions. Each instruction corresponds to the determined programming instruction and is configured with the associated API to accept input parameters generated from identified information within the input data, output parameters from the execution of any of the set of programming instructions, or a combination thereof. Finally, the method involves processing the computer instructions, leading to the generation of output data.

title: Image recognition task execution method and device, equipment and medium
