abstract: The invention discloses an image recognition task execution method and device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of image processing, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a current weight matrix in a process of executing an image recognition task through employing an image recognition model based on a neural network, and adjusting the column weight of the current weight matrix, generating a plurality of candidate weight matrixes; the current weight matrix stores association strength information of each image feature; dividing each candidate weight matrix into a plurality of block matrixes, and screening out a target weight matrix from the plurality of candidate weight matrixes based on a weight difference value among the plurality of block matrixes; processing the target weight matrix based on the target pruning proportion to obtain a pruning weight from the target weight matrix; and updating the image recognition model by using the pruning weight, and executing the image recognition task by using the updated image recognition model. According to the invention, the calculation efficiency of image recognition is improved, and the accuracy of image recognition is improved.

title: Comprehensive energy system scheduling method and device based on particle swarm optimization
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated energy system scheduling method and device based on a particle swarm algorithm, and relates to the technical field of energy and communication systems. According to the method, optimal scheduling can be carried out under a relatively small time scale of the IES, and the uncertainty and challenge of renewable energy power generation and load requirements are solved. While a stepped carbon transaction mechanism is considered, the accuracy and availability of multi-time scale scheduling are improved, and a promising solution is provided for low-carbon economic scheduling. Meanwhile, parameters in an existing multi-time-scale multi-objective optimization low-carbon economic dispatching model solving algorithm are determined through empirical evaluation and need to be manually and repeatedly adjusted, the timeliness of the algorithm is reduced, and the obtained dispatching result has a lifting space. The particle swarm parameter optimization method based on reinforcement learning can objectively give parameter initial values, and the solving speed of a scheduling strategy is improved.

title: Identity recognition and authentication method for video gait recognition based on big data technology
abstract: The invention discloses an identity recognition authentication method for video gait recognition based on a big data technology, and relates to the technical field of biological feature recognition, video analysis and big data processing. And carrying out identity authentication by adopting an improved cross entropy-triple mixed loss function. The method has the core advantages that an optical flow field dynamic background suppression algorithm is provided for a complex scene, under the conditions of dynamic shielding and low resolution (smaller than or equal to 640 * 480), the recognition accuracy of a CAS IA-B data set reaches 95.6% and is improved by 6.4% compared with that of a traditional ST-GCN method (89.2%), the dynamic background segmentation error rate is reduced to 4.7% from 15.2%, and the problem of feature drift is effectively solved. According to the technical scheme, the efficiency bottleneck of a traditional frame is broken through, and PB-level data processing delay lt is achieved; compared with a Hadoop scheme, the method has the advantages that the speed is increased by 75%, the memory occupation is reduced to 2.3 GB, and feasibility is provided for edge computing deployment. (character 276).

title: Federal mechanism-based computing power resource dynamic migration scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention provides a computing power resource dynamic migration scheduling method and system based on a federation mechanism, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, obtaining the computing power resource information of a federation computing power cluster; and task computing power request information is determined according to the computing task request of the user in the single time slot. And then, according to the computing power resource information and the task computing power request information, establishing a computing power optimization model so as to solve and determine a task unloading scheme. And finally, scheduling the calculation task request to the target calculation power node for calculation according to the task unloading scheme. According to the method, computing power resource grid connection and computing power resource unification of satellite sub-cluster computing power nodes are realized through a Karmada architecture, and an unloading problem of a computing task request is modeled as an optimization problem. Therefore, online dynamic migration of the computing power resources can be realized according to the computing task request of the user. And cross-cluster scheduling can be carried out among a plurality of satellite sub-cluster computing power nodes, so that the utilization rate of computing power resources is greatly improved, and the computing power resources are fully and effectively utilized.

title: Molecular discovery-oriented multi-party cooperation federal learning model method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of federated learning and molecular discovery, in particular to a multi-party cooperation federated learning model method for molecular discovery. The invention discloses a multi-party cooperation federation learning model method for molecular discovery. A heterogeneous difference privacy technology is introduced into each local client, and it is ensured that molecular local model parameters are protected in the training process. Next, the protected local model parameter information is uploaded to a central server, projection transformation and weighted averaging are carried out through a Lanczos algorithm, and finally new global model parameters are generated and released to a client for multiple times of communication updating training; according to the method, the privacy protection problem of different molecular data sources is effectively solved by utilizing heterogeneous differential privacy, so that the privacy of the molecular data is guaranteed; and meanwhile, a Lanczos algorithm is adopted to carry out projection transformation to optimize a molecular model fusion mode in a multi-party cooperation process, new global model parameters are generated, and the prediction accuracy of the molecular model can be improved.

title: Ubiquitous embedded terminal-oriented asynchronous personalized federal learning method
abstract: The invention discloses an asynchronous personalized federated learning method for a ubiquitous embedded terminal, and particularly relates to the field of federated learning based on edge intelligence. Comprising the following steps: receiving model parameters uploaded by a client; determining a plurality of initial clustering center models according to an uploading sequence of the model parameters, and determining a client associated with each initial clustering center model; determining a feedback value of each client to the initial clustering center model; establishing a new clustering center model according to the feedback value corresponding to each initial clustering center model; determining the deviation between each new clustering center model and the corresponding initial clustering center model; issuing the new clustering center model to a corresponding client according to the deviation; and receiving model parameters uploaded by the client, and updating and aggregating the model parameters to the corresponding new clustering center model to complete asynchronous personalized federal learning. The problem of model updating hysteresis in an existing asynchronous federal learning method can be solved.

title: Method and system for promoting achievement transformation based on precision butt joint of industry, university and research
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for promoting achievement transformation based on industry-university-research accurate connection, and relates to the technical field of industry-university-research, and the method comprises the steps: collecting multi-modal data of an industry-university-research subject, carrying out the preprocessing, and generating a dynamic knowledge graph representing the incidence relation between technical capability and resources; outputting a potential cooperation scheme and a corresponding resource demand vector based on the graph mining technology association path; in the virtual resource pool, a resource scheduling strategy is generated through a multi-agent reinforcement learning model; coordinating resource data of each participant based on a federated learning protocol, and executing cross-mechanism resource allocation; and according to the actual scheduling effect data, synchronously correcting the association weight of the knowledge graph and the parameters of the reinforcement learning model. According to the method, cross-mechanism resource optimization scheduling is realized, the knowledge graph is dynamically adjusted, and the matching accuracy is improved. The adaptability and the stability are enhanced through a feedback optimization strategy, and the system robustness and the resource scheduling efficiency are improved in combination with a consistency index and a version backtracking mechanism.

title: An intelligent scheduling system for building construction progress based on BIM
abstract: An intelligent scheduling system for building construction progress based on BIM, including a data collection module, which collects construction progress, resource and environmental data in real time through a sensor network, mobile terminals and on-site monitoring devices to achieve information sharing. The data processing module adopts big data analysis technology to clean and integrate data, extract effective information, and optimize the construction progress and resource consumption model using machine learning to provide accurate data support for intelligent scheduling. The BIM integration module combines the BIM model with the construction progress data to achieve three-dimensional visual display, support construction plan simulation and optimization, and improve the level of refined management. The intelligent scheduling module dynamically generates and adjusts the construction schedule based on the artificial intelligence algorithm to achieve intelligent task allocation and reasonable resource scheduling. The user interaction module supports multi-terminal access, and users can view progress information and adjust plans in real time to achieve real-time monitoring and dynamic adjustment of the construction progress.

title: Vehicle trajectory tree structure including learned trajectories
abstract: Techniques for generating a tree structure based on multiple machine-learned trajectories are described herein. A planning component (“ML system”) within a vehicle may receive and encode various types of sensor and/or vehicle data. The ML system can provide the encoded data as input to multiple machine-learning models (“ML models”), each of which may be trained to output a unique candidate trajectory for the vehicle follow. In some examples, each ML model may be trained to output a unique type of learned trajectory that causes the vehicle to perform a certain type of action. Using the learned candidate trajectories, the ML system may generate a tree structure that includes some or all of the candidate trajectories. The vehicle may determine a control trajectory based on the generation and traversal of the tree structure using a tree search algorithm, and may follow the control trajectory within the environment.
